source: پدیده کشند سرخ وقتی رخ می‌دهد که تراکم کارنیا برویس، نوعی جاندار دریایی تک‌سلولی که به‌صورت طبیعی پدید می‌آید، بالاتر از حد عادی باشد.
english_gold: Red tide is caused by a higher than normal concentration of Karenia brevis, a naturally-occurring single-celled marine organism.
english_hypothesis: The phenomenon of "Red Tide" occurs when the concentration of Karenia brevis, a type of marine single-celled organism that naturally occurs, exceeds normal levels.

source: عوامل طبیعی می‌توانند در ایجاد شرایط مطلوب با هم تلاقی داشته باشند و باعث افزایش چشمگیر تعداد این جلبک شوند.
english_gold: Natural factors can intersect to produce ideal conditions, allowing this algae to increase in number dramatically.
english_hypothesis: Natural factors can converge to create favorable conditions and significantly increase the number of this algae.

source: جلبک‌ها نوعی نوروتوکسین تولید می‌کنند که می‌تواند سیستم عصبی را هم در انسان‌ها و هم ماهی‌ها از کار بیاندازد.
english_gold: The algae produces a neurotoxin that can disable nerves in both humans and fish.
english_hypothesis: Algae produce a neurotoxin that can paralyze the nervous system in both humans and fish.

source: ماهی‌ها به علت غلظت بالای سم موجود در آب می‌میرند.
english_gold: Fish often die because of the high concentrations of the toxin in the waters.
english_hypothesis: The fish die due to the high concentration of poison in the water.

source: انسان در اثر استنشاق آب آلوده‌ای که به دلیل وزیدن باد و امواج به هوا وارد شده، می‌تواند مبتلا شود.
english_gold: Humans can be affected by breathing affected water taken into the air by wind and waves.
english_hypothesis: Inhalation of contaminated water that has been blown into the air by wind and waves can cause illness in humans.

source: اتم را می‌توان یکی از بلوک‌های ساختاری بنیادی تمام مواد در نظر گرفت.
english_gold: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.
english_hypothesis: The atom can be considered one of the fundamental structural blocks of all matter.

source: این یک موجودیت بسیار پیچیده است، که بنابر یک مدل ساده شده بور از یک هسته مرکزی و الکترون‌هایی که به دورش می‌چرخنده ساخته شده است، چیزی شبیه به سیارات دور خورشید - به شکل 1.1 مراجعه کنید.
english_gold: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.
english_hypothesis: This is a very complex entity, which, according to a simplified model, is similar to the solar system, with a central nucleus and electrons orbiting around it, as described in section 1.1.

source: هسته از دو نوع از ذرات تشکیل شده - نوترون‌ها و پروتون‌ها.
english_gold: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.
english_hypothesis: The nucleus is composed of two types of particles: neutrons and protons.

source: پروتون‌ها بار الکتریکی مثبت دارند درحالی که نوترون‌ها فاقد بار هستند. الکترون‌ها دارای بار الکتریکی منفی می‌باشند.
english_gold: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.
english_hypothesis: Protons have a positive electric charge, while neutrons have no charge. Electrons have a negative electric charge.

source: عناصر و ترکیبات می‌توانند بدون تغییر، از یک حالت به حالت دیگر جابجا شوند.
english_gold: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.
english_hypothesis: Elements and compounds can be moved from one state to another without change.

source: نیتروژن به عنوان یک گاز هنوز همان ویژگی های نیتروژن مایع را دارد. حالت مایع متراکم تر است اما مولکول ها کماکان همان‌ها هستند.
english_gold: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.
english_hypothesis: Nitrogen, as a gas, still retains the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser, but the molecules are still the same.

source: آب نمونه دیگری است. آب از دو اتم هیدروژن و یک اتم اکسیژن مرکب تشکیل شده است.
english_gold: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
english_hypothesis: Water is another example. Water is composed of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

source: ساختار مولکولی آن چه گاز باشد و چه مایع یا جامد، یکسان است.
english_gold: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.
english_hypothesis: The molecular structure of it, whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid, is the same.

source: با اینکه حالت فیزیکی آن ممکن است عوض شود، حالت شیمیایی آن تغییری نمی‌کند.
english_gold: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.
english_hypothesis: The chemical state of the substance remains unchanged, even if its physical state changes.

source: تورنادو ستونی از هوای خیلی کم‌فشار چرخنده است که هوای اطراف را به داخلی و به بالا می‌کشد.
english_gold: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.
english_hypothesis: A tornado is a column of rotating air that forms when a thunderstorm's updrafts and downdrafts interact with the surrounding environment.

source: آنها قیفی شکل شروع می‌شوند در حالی که از ابرهای طوفانی پایین می‌آیند و وقتی به زمین می‌رسند، تبدیل به «گردباد» می‌شوند.
english_gold: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.
english_hypothesis: They start to form a conical shape as they descend from stormy clouds, and when they reach the ground, they become "tornadoes."

source: آنها بادهای خیلی قوی (اغلب با سرعت 100 تا 200 مایل بر ساعت) تولید می‌کنند و می‌توانند اشیاء سنگین را از زمین بلند کنند که با حرکت گردباد جابجا می‌شوند.
english_gold: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.
english_hypothesis: They produce very strong winds (often at speeds of 100 to 200 miles per hour) and can lift heavy objects off the ground, which are then carried away by the tornado.

source: گردبادها در مقایسه با سایر طوفان‌های خروشان، قسمت کوچکتری را در می‌نوردند، اما می‌توانند هرچیزی را در سر راهشان خراب کنند.
english_gold: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.
english_hypothesis: Tornadoes, in comparison to other turbulent storms, cover a smaller area, but can cause destruction to anything in their path.

source: گردبادها درختان را از ریشه می‌کنند، تخته‌های ساختمانی را تکه پاره می‌کنند، و خودروها را به آسمان پرتاب می‌کنند. دو درصد از خروشان‌ترین گردبادها بیش از دو ساعت ادامه پیدا می‌کنند.
english_gold: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.
english_hypothesis: Tornadoes uproot trees, shatter building boards, and toss cars into the air. Two percent of the most turbulent tornadoes last for more than two hours.

source: این امر نه تنها تأیید می‌کند که حداقل برخی از دایناسورها دارای پر بودند، نظریه‌ای که قبلاً در محافل علمی شایع شده است، بلکه اطلاعاتی را در اختیار قرار می‌دهد که فسیل‌ها به طور کلی نمی‌توانند این اطلاعات را بدهند، مواردی از قبیل رنگ و چیدمان سه‌بعدی.
english_gold: This not only confirms that at least some dinosaurs had feathers, a theory already widespread, but provides details fossils generally cannot, such as color and three-dimensional arrangement.
english_hypothesis: This not only confirms that at least some dinosaurs had feathers, a theory that has been widely discussed in scientific circles, but also provides information that fossils cannot provide, such as color and three-dimensional arrangement.

source: دانشمندان می گویند که پرهای زینتی این حیوان در بالای به رنگ شاه بلوط قهوه ای و در پایین به رنگ کاروتنوئید بود.
english_gold: . Scientists say this animal's plumage was chestnut-brown on top with a pale or carotenoid-colored underside.
english_hypothesis: Scientists say that the ornamental feathers of this animal were brown above, like the color of a walnut, and carotenoid below.

source: این یافته همچنین شناخت ما را در مورد تکامل پرها در پرندگان بیشتر می‌کند.
english_gold: The find also grants insight into the evolution of feathers in birds.
english_hypothesis: This finding also increases our understanding of the evolution of feathers in birds.

source: از آنجا که پرهای این دایناسور میله‌ای که بخوبی توسعه یافته باشد ندارند که به آن ساقه گفته می‌شود، اما سایر ویژگی‌های پرها را دارند- ریش و موهای ریز - لذا محققان چنین استدلال می‌کنند که پیشرفت تکاملی ساقه احتمالاً دیرتر از سایر ویژگی‌ها بوده است.
english_gold: Because the dinosaur feathers do not have a well-developed shaft, called a rachis, but do have other features of feathers — barbs and barbules — the researchers inferred the rachis was likely a later evolutionary development that these other features.
english_hypothesis: Since this dinosaur lacks the rod-like structure known as the "shaft" that has well-developed in other birds, but retains other feather characteristics - ruff and downy hair - researchers argue that the evolutionary development of the shaft likely occurred later than other feather features.

source: ساختار پرها نشان می‌دهد که در پرواز مورد استفاده قرار نمی‌گرفتند بلکه برای تنظیم دما یا نمایش استفاده می‌شدند. محققان معتقدند كه حتی اگر این دم یک دایناسور جوان باشد، باز هم این نمونه نشان دهنده پر حیوان بالغ است نه کرک یک جوجه.
english_gold: The feathers' structure suggests that they were not used in flight but rather for temperature regulation or display. The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
english_hypothesis: The structure of the feathers indicates that they were not used for flight, but rather for regulating temperature or display purposes. Researchers believe that even if this is a juvenile dinosaur, the sample still represents the feathers of an adult animal, not the down of a chick.

source: تأثیری که این تیم بدنبال آن بود توسط نیروهای موجی بین ماده تاریک کهکشان و ماده تاریک کهکشان راه شیری سبب خواهد شد.
english_gold: The effect the team was looking for would be caused by tidal forces between the galaxy's dark matter and the Milky Way's dark matter.
english_hypothesis: The effect that this team is pursuing will be caused by the forces of the wave-like interaction between the dark matter of the Andromeda galaxy and the dark matter of the Milky Way galaxy.

source: همانطور که ماه نیروی کششی بر زمین اعمال می‌کند و سبب موج‌هایی می‌شود، راه شیری نیز نیرویی بر کهکشان قوس وارد می‌کند.
english_gold: Just like the moon exerts a pull on the earth, causing tides, so does the Milky Way exert a force on the Sagittarius galaxy.
english_hypothesis: Just as the moon exerts a force on the Earth, causing waves, the Milky Way also exerts a force on the Sagittarius galaxy.

source: دانشمندان توانستند نتیجه بگیرند که ماده تاریک به شکلی یکسان با ماده معمول بر ماده تاریک دیگر تأثیر می‌گذارد.
english_gold: The scientists were able to conclude that the dark matter affect other dark matter in the same way regular matter does.
english_hypothesis: Scientists have been able to conclude that dark matter affects dark matter in the same way that normal matter affects normal matter.

source: این نظریه می‌گوید که اکثر مواد تاریکِ دور یک کهکشان، دور یک کهکشان به شکل هاله می‌باشند و از مقادیر زیادی ذرات کوچک تشکیل شده‌اند.
english_gold: This theory says that most dark matter around a galaxy is located around a galaxy in a kind of halo, and is made of lots of small particles.
english_hypothesis: This theory posits that most dark matter in the outer regions of a galaxy is distributed in a halo-like shape around the galaxy and is composed of a large number of small particles.

source: اسید سیانوریک و نیز ملامین در نمونه‌های ادرار حیوانات خانگی که پس از مصرف غذای آلوده مخصوص حیوانات مردند، یافت شد.
english_gold: Both cyanuric acid and melamine were found in urine samples from pets that died after consuming contaminated pet food.
english_hypothesis: Acid cyanide and also malamine were found in the urine samples of domestic animals that died after consuming contaminated animal feed.

source: محققان دانشگاه گفتند که این دو ترکیب در واکنش با یکدیگر مواد کریستالی تشکیل می‌دهد و می‌تواند عملکرد کلیه را مسدود کند.
english_gold: The two compounds react with one another to form crystals that may block kidney function, researchers at the university said.
english_hypothesis: Scientists at the university said that these two compounds form crystalline materials when they react with each other and can block kidney function.

source: پژوهشگران با افزودن ملامین و اسید سیانوریک در ادرار گربه، تشکیل کریستال‌ها را مشاهده کردند.
english_gold: The researchers observed crystals formed in cat urine by the addition of melamine and cyanuric acid.
english_hypothesis: Researchers observed the formation of crystals by adding malachite green and cyanuric acid to cat urine.

source: نتیجه سنجش طیف سنجی مادون قرمز (طیف‌سنجی تبدیل فوریه فروسرخ) مشخص کرد ترکیب این بلورها با مواردی که در ادرار حیوانات خانگی مبتلا دیده می‌شود مطابقت دارد.
english_gold: The composition of these crystals matches those found in the urine of affected pets when compared by infrared spectroscopy (FTIR).
english_hypothesis: The result of the infrared spectroscopy (Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy) analysis revealed that the composition of these crystals matches the ones found in the urine of animals suffering from the disease.

source: به این پدیده pH شیمیایی گفته می‌شود. می‌توانید یک شاخص با استفاده از آب کلم قرمز درست کنید.
english_gold: This is called a chemical's pH. You can make an indicator using red cabbage juice.
english_hypothesis: This phenomenon is referred to as pH in chemistry. You can make an indicator using red cabbage juice.

source: آب کلم بسته میزان اسیدی یا بازی (قلیایی) بودن ماده شیمیایی تغییر رنگ می‌دهد.
english_gold: The cabbage juice changes color depending on how acidic or basic (alkaline) the chemical is.
english_hypothesis: The pH of a solution changes the color of the chemical.

source: سطح pH توسط مقدار یون‌های هیدروژن (H در pH) در ماده شیمیایی تست‌شده نشان داده می‌شود.
english_gold: The pH level is indicated by the amount of Hydrogen (the H in pH) ions in the tested chemical.
english_hypothesis: The pH level is indicated by the amount of hydrogen ions (H+) in the chemical substance being tested.

source: یون‌های هیدروژن پروتون‌هایی هستند که الکترون از آنها گرفته شده است (زیرا اتم‌های هیدروژن فقط از یک پروتون و یک الکترون تشکیل می‌شوند).
english_gold: Hydrogen ions are protons that had their electrons stripped off them (since Hydrogen atoms consist of one proton and one electron).
english_hypothesis: Hydrogen ions are protons that have lost an electron (since hydrogen atoms are composed of only one proton and one electron).

source: زمانی که گروه کوچکی از موجودات زنده (جامعه‌ای کوچک) از جامعه اصلی که به آن متعلق است جدا می‌شود (مثل زمانی که به آن سوی رشته کوه یا رودخانه نقل مکان می‌کنند، یا وقتی به جزیره‌ای جدید می‌روند که نمی‌توانند به‌راحتی بازگردند)، اغلب درمی‌یابند که در محیطی متفاوت از محیط قبلی‌شان هستند.
english_gold: When a small group of living things (a small population) gets separated from the main population that they came from (like if they move over a mountain range or a river, or if they move to a new island so that they can't easily move back) they will often find themselves in a different environment than they were in before.
english_hypothesis: When a small group of living beings (a small community) separates from the main community to which they belong (such as when they move to the other side of a mountain range or a river, or when they go to a new island from which they cannot easily return), they often find themselves in a different environment from their previous one.

source: این محیط جدید دارای منابع و رقبای مختلف است، پس جمعیت جدید برای اینکه یک رقیب قوی به حساب آید، سوای از آنچه قبلاً احتیاج داشتند، به قابلیت‌ها یا سازگاری‌های متفاوت نیاز خواهد داشت.
english_gold: This new environment has different resources and different competitors, so the new population will need different features or adaptations to be a strong competitor than what they had needed before.
english_hypothesis: This new environment has different resources and competitors, so the new population will need different capabilities or adaptability to be a strong competitor.

source: سرانجام پس از هزاران یا حتی میلیون‌ها سال، دو جمعیت آنقدر متفاوت خواهند بود که نمی‌توان آنها را از یک گونه تلقی کرد.
english_gold: Eventually, after thousands or even millions of years, the two populations will look so different that they can't be called the same species.
english_hypothesis: After thousands or even millions of years, the two populations will be so different that they cannot be considered the same species.

source: ما این فرایند را گونه‌زایی می نامیم، که فقط به معنی تشکیل گونه‌های جدید است. گونه‌زایی یک نتیجه غیرقابل اجتناب و بخش مهمی از تکامل است.
english_gold: We call this process speciation, which just means the formation of new species. Speciation is an unavoidable consequence and a very important part of evolution.
english_hypothesis: We call this process speciation, which simply means the formation of new species. Speciation is an inevitable outcome and an important part of evolution.

source: موساسور برترین شکارچی در دوره خود بود، به همین خاطر از هیچ چیز نمی‌ترسید، مگر سایر موساسورها.
english_gold: Mosasaurus was the apex predator of its time, so it feared nothing, except other mosasaurs.
english_hypothesis: Mosasaur was the top predator of its time, so it feared nothing, except other mosasaurs.

source: آرواره های بلند آن با بیش از 70 دندان به تیزی تیغ، همراه با یک مجموعه اضافه در سقف دهانش پر شده بود، و معنی آن این است که برای هر چیزی که از مسیر آن عبور کند، فراری وجود ندارد.
english_gold: Its long jaws were studded with more than 70 razor-sharp teeth, along with an extra set in the roof of its mouth, meaning that there was no escape for anything that crossed its path.
english_hypothesis: The long, serrated fangs, with over 70 teeth, were like a razor's edge, and the additional set in the roof of its mouth meant there was no escape for anything that crossed its path.

source: مطمئن نیستیم اما شاید زبانی دوشاخه داشته است. غذای آن شامل لاک‌پشت‌ها، ماهی‌های بزرگ و سایر موساسورها بود و حتی ممکن است همجنس‌خوار نیز بوده باشد.
english_gold: We don't know for sure, but it may have had a forked tongue. Its diet included turtles, large fish, other mosasaurs, and it may even have been a cannibal.
english_hypothesis: We are not certain, but it may have been a polyglot. Its diet consisted of turtles, large fish, and other mosasaurs, and it may have also been a homosexual.

source: همچنین به هر چیزی که وارد آب شود حمله می‌کند؛ حتی یک دایناسور غول‌پیکر مانند تیرکس برای آن فرقی نخواهد داشت.
english_gold: It also attacked anything that entered the water; even a giant dinosaur such as T. rex would be no match for it.
english_hypothesis: It attacks anything that enters the water; even a gigantic dinosaur like Tyrannosaurus Rex will not be spared.

source: حشرات اولین دسته از حیوانات بودند که به هوا می‌رفتند. توانایی‌شان در پرواز به آنها کمک کرد که راحت‌تر از دشمن بگریزند و بهتر بتوانند غذا و جفت پیدا کنند.
english_gold: Insects were the first animals to take to the air. Their ability to fly helped them evade enemies more easily and find food and mates more efficiently.
english_hypothesis: Insects were the first group of animals to fly. Their ability to fly helped them escape from predators more easily and find food and mates more effectively.

source: اکثر حشرات این قابلیت را دارند که بال‌هایشان را از پشت در امتداد بدنشان برگردانند.
english_gold: Most insects have the advantage of being able to fold their wings back along the body.
english_hypothesis: Most insects have the ability to fold their wings back along their body.

source: این توانایی امکان پنهان شدن از دست شکارچیان را در طیف وسیع‌تری از فضاهای کوچک به آنها می‌دهد.
english_gold: This gives them a wider range of small places to hide from predators.
english_hypothesis: This ability allows them to hide from predators in a wider range of smaller spaces.

source: امروزه تنها حشراتی که نمی‌توانند بال‌های خود را به پشت جمع کنند سنجاقک‌ها و پشه‌های یک‌روزه هستند.
english_gold: Today, the only insects that cannot fold back their wings are dragon flies and mayflies.
english_hypothesis: Today, only the dragonflies and mosquitoes are unable to fold their wings behind their backs.

source: در مورد تعداد افرادی که به زبان هندی صحبت می‌کنند برآوردهای مختلفی وجود دارد. برآورد شده است که این زبان جایگاهی بین دوم تا چهارم را در زبان‌های پرکاربرد جهان دارد.
english_gold: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.
english_hypothesis: There are various estimates regarding the number of people who speak Hindi. It is estimated that Hindi ranks between the second and fourth most widely spoken languages in the world.

source: تعداد متکلمان بومی بستگی به این دارد که گویش‌های خیلی نزدیک در شمارش محسوب شده باشند یا نه.
english_gold: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.
english_hypothesis: The number of native speakers depends on whether very similar dialects are counted or not.

source: تخمین تعداد سخنگویان بین 340 میلیون تا 500 میلیون متغیر است و تا 800 میلیون نفر می‌توانند این زبان را متوجه شوند.
english_gold: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.
english_hypothesis: The number of speakers is estimated to be between 340 million and 500 million, and up to 800 million people may be able to understand this language.

source: هندی و اردو در واژگان مشابه اما از نظر حروف الفبا متفاوت هستند؛ در مکالمه‌های روزمره، گویندگان هر دو زبان معمولاً می‌توانند یکدیگر را درک کنند.
english_gold: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.
english_hypothesis: Hindi and Urdu have similar vocabularies but differ in their alphabets; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages usually can understand each other.

source: اختلال نقص توجه «یک سندرم عصبی است که علائم سه گانه آن شامل تحریک پذیری، حواس پرتی، بیش فعالی یا انرژی بیش از حد» است.
english_gold: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".
english_hypothesis: Attention Deficit Disorder (ADD) is a neurological syndrome characterized by three primary symptoms: hyperactivity, distractibility, and excessive energy.

source: این پدیده ناتوانی یادگیری نیست، بلکه اختلال یادگیری است؛ «بین 3 تا 5 درصد از همه کودکان دچار آن هستند، احتمالاً چیزی حدود 2 میلیون کودک آمریکایی».
english_gold: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".
english_hypothesis: This phenomenon is not learning disability, but learning disorder; "between 3 to 5 percent of all children are affected by it, approximately 2 million American children."

source: از آنجایی که مغز این کودکان با روش‌های عادی قابل تحریک نیست، آن‌ها عموماً مشکلات زیادی را تحمل می‌کنند، زیرا برای تحریک مغز خود «رفتارهای پرخطری از خود بروز می‌دهند و وارد دعوا می‌شوند و اقتدار شخص را به چالش می‌کشند».
english_gold: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.
english_hypothesis: Because the brains of these children cannot be stimulated in the usual ways, they generally have a lot of problems, as they resort to dangerous behaviors to stimulate their brains, get into fights, and challenge authority.

source: ADD بر روابط با سایر همسالان تأثیر می‌گذارد زیرا سایر کودکان نمی‌توانند بفهمند که چرا آنها به این روش عمل می‌کند یا چرا به این صورت هجی می‌کنند یا اینکه سطح بلوغ آنها فرق دارد.
english_gold: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.
english_hypothesis: This sentence translates to: "It affects relationships with other peers because other children cannot understand why they behave in this manner or why they are pronounced in this way, or that their level of maturity is different."

source: دکتر تونی مول موفق شد سل بسیار مقاوم به دارو (XDR-TB) را در منطقه کوازولو-ناتال در آفریقای جنوبی کشف کند.
english_gold: Dr. Tony Moll discovered the Extremely Drug Resistant Tuberculosis (XDR-TB) in the South African region KwaZulu-Natal.
english_hypothesis: Dr. Tony Moll successfully discovered the highly drug-resistant form of tuberculosis (XDR-TB) in the KwaZulu-Natal region of South Africa.

source: دکتر مول فکر می کند که برخی از بیماران ممکن است در بیمارستان با ساس داشته باشند، و حداقل دو نفر از آنها کارمندان بهداشت بیمارستان بودند.
english_gold: Some patients might have contracted the bug in the hospital, Dr. Moll thinks, and at least two were hospital health workers.
english_hypothesis: The doctor thinks that some patients may have had scabies in the hospital, and at least two of them were hospital staff.

source: در مدت یک سال، ‌یک شخص مبتلا شده ممکن است 10 تا 15 نفر از کسانی که تماس نزدیک داشته‌اند را مبتلا کند.
english_gold: In one year's time, an infected person may infect 10 to 15 close contacts.
english_hypothesis: In a period of one year, a person who has contracted the disease may infect 10 to 15 people out of those they have had close contact with.

source: با وجود این، درصد XDR-TB در کل گروه افراد مبتلا به سل هنوز به نظر کم می‌رسد؛ 6,000 مورد ابتلا از کل 330,000 در یک لحظه خاص در آفریقای جنوبی.
english_gold: However, the percentage of XDR-TB in the entire group of people with tuberculosis still seems to be low; 6,000 of the total 330,000 people infected at any particular moment in South Africa.
english_hypothesis: Despite this, the percentage of XDR-TB among the entire group of TB patients still appears to be low; 6,000 cases out of a total of 330,000 in a specific moment in time in South Africa.

source: اولین مورد این بیماری در این فصل در اواخر جولای گزارش شد.
english_gold: The first cases of the disease this season were reported in late July.
english_hypothesis: The first case of this disease in this season was reported in late July.

source: خوک‌ها حامل این بیماری هستند و سپس از طریق پشه ها به انسان منتقل می‌شود.
english_gold: The disease is carried by pigs, which then migrates to humans through mosquitos.
english_hypothesis: Pigs are carriers of this disease and then it is transmitted to humans through mosquitoes.

source: شیوع این بیماری دولت هند را واداشته تا به اقداماتی مثل اعزام شکارچیان خوک در مناطق شدیداً‌ آلوده، توزیع هزاران پشه‌بند و پاشیدن حشره‌کش مبادرت ورزد.
english_gold: The outbreak has prompted the Indian government to undertake such measures as deployment of pig catchers in seriously affected areas, distributing thousands of mosquito curtains and spraying pesticides.
english_hypothesis: The spread of this disease has prompted the Indian government to take measures such as deploying pig hunters in heavily infested areas, distributing thousands of mosquito nets, and spraying insecticides.

source: طرح‌های واکسن‌رسانی به مناطقی که امسال به‌لحاظ تاریخی بیشترین بیماری را داشته‌اند به دلیل کمبود بودجه و اولویت‌دهی پایین این بیماری نسبت به سایر بیماری‌ها به تأخیر افتاد.
english_gold: Plans for vaccines to be delivered to the historically most affected areas this year were delayed due to lack of funds and low prioritisation relative to other diseases.
english_hypothesis: Vaccination plans for areas that historically have the highest disease rates this year have been delayed due to budget constraints and low priority given to this disease compared to other diseases.

source: یکی از معمول‌ترین روش‌هایی که برای شرح اهمیت جامعه‌پذیری استفاده می‌شود کمک گرفتن از موارد تأسف‌بار کودکانی است که در جریان رشد بخاطر غفلت، بداقبالی، یا تعرض عمدی از بزرگسالان جامعه‌پذیری را یاد نگرفتند.
english_gold: One of the most common methods used to illustrate the importance of socialization is to draw upon the few unfortunate cases of children who were, through neglect, misfortune, or wilful abuse, not socialized by adults while they were growing up.
english_hypothesis: One of the most common methods used to explain the importance of socialization is to refer to unfortunate cases of children who, due to neglect, abuse, or intentional maltreatment by adults, have not learned socialization during their growth.

source: این نوع از بچه‌ها «وحشی» نامیده می‌شوند. برخی از این کودکان وحشی توسط مردم (معمولا والدین خودشان) محبوس می‌شوند؛ در برخی از موارد این رهاسازی کودک بدلیل انکار والدین به نقص عقلانی و فیزیکی شدید کودک می‌باشد.
english_gold: Such children are called "feral" or wild. Some feral children have been confined by people (usually their own parents); in some cases this child abandonment was due to the parents' rejection of a child's severe intellectual or physical impairment.
english_hypothesis: This type of child is called "wild." Some of these wild children are confined by people (usually their own parents); in some cases, the child is released due to the parents' denial of the child's severe physical and mental deficiency.

source: کودکان وحشی ممکن است قبل از ترک شدن یا فرار کردن کودک آزاری شدید یا ضربه‌ای عاطفی را تجربه کرده باشند.
english_gold: Feral children may have experienced severe child abuse or trauma before being abandoned or running away.
english_hypothesis: Children who are feral may have experienced severe child abuse or emotional trauma before being abandoned or running away.

source: ادعا می‌شود که بقیه توسط حیوانات بزرگ شده‌اند؛ گفته شده است برخی به تنهایی در حیات وحش زندگی کرده‌اند.
english_gold: Others are alleged to have been brought up by animals; some are said to have lived in the wild on their own.
english_hypothesis: It is claimed that the rest have been raised by animals; it is said that some have lived alone in the wild.

source: کودکان به دلایل متعددی به خانه‌های پرستاری سپرده می‌شوند. دامنه این دلایل از غفلت تا تعرض، و حتی اخاذی گسترش دارد.
english_gold: Children are placed in Foster Care for a wide variety of reasons that range from neglect, to abuse, and even to extortion.
english_hypothesis: Children are entrusted to childcare centers for various reasons. The range of these reasons extends from neglect to abuse, and even extortion.

source: هیچ کودکی نباید مجبور شود در محیطی فاقد تغذیه، مراقبت و تربیت رشد کند، اما این اتفاق می‌افتد.
english_gold: No child should ever have to grow up in an environment that is not nurturing, caring, and educational, but they do.
english_hypothesis: No child should be forced to grow up in an environment lacking nutrition, care, and education, but this happens.

source: ما سیستم مراقبت از کودکان بی‌سرپرست را منطقه‌ای امن برای این کودکان می‌دانیم.
english_gold: We perceive the Foster Care System to be a safety zone for these children.
english_hypothesis: We consider the system of care for orphaned children a safe haven for these children.

source: سیستم پرورش و مراقبت ما می‌کوشد خانه‌های امن، مراقب‌های با محبت، آموزش پایدار و مراقبت‌های بهداشتی قابل اطمینان را فراهم کند.
english_gold: Our foster care system is supposed to provide safe homes, loving caregivers, stable education, and reliable health care.
english_hypothesis: Our system of care and nurturing strives to provide safe homes, loving care, sustainable education, and reliable healthcare.

source: برای فرزند‌خواندگی لازم است تمام فقدان نیازهای فرزند‌خوانده در خانه قبلی که از آن آورده شده است فراهم شود.
english_gold: Foster care is supposed to provide all the necessities that were lacking in the home they were previously taken from.
english_hypothesis: For adoption, it is necessary to provide all the needs of the adoptee that were brought from the previous home.

source: همه در جامعه مشارکت می‌کند و از سیستم‌های حمل‌ونقل استفاده می‌کند. تقریباً همه از سیستم حمل‌ونقل شکایت دارند.
english_gold: Everyone participates in society and uses transportation systems. Almost everyone complains about transportation systems.
english_hypothesis: Everyone in the society participates and uses the transportation systems. Almost everyone complains about the transportation system.

source: در کشورهای توسعه یافته بندرت سطح مشابهی از شکایات را درمورد کیفیت آب یا سقوط پلها می شنوید.
english_gold: In developed countries you seldom hear similar levels of complaints about water quality or bridges falling down.
english_hypothesis: In developed countries, you rarely hear complaints about the quality of water or bridge collapses.

source: چرا سیستم‌های حمل و نقل سبب چنین شکایت‌هایی شده است، چرا هر روز شاهد ناکامی آنها می‌باشیم؟ آیا این بخاطر ناکارامدی مهندس‌های وسایل نقلیه است؟ یا دلیل اساسی‌تری وجود دارد؟
english_gold: Why do transportation systems engender such complaints, why do they fail on a daily basis? Are transportation engineers just incompetent? Or is something more fundamental going on?
english_hypothesis: Why have transportation systems become the cause of such complaints, and why do we witness their failure every day? Is it due to the incompetence of vehicle engineers, or is there a more fundamental reason?

source: متأسفانه مطالعه جریان ترافیک مشکل است، زیرا رفتار راننده را نمی‌توان با قطعیت صد درصد پیش‌بینی کرد.
english_gold: Unfortunately, studying traffic flow is difficult because driver behavior cannot be predicted with one-hundred percent certainty.
english_hypothesis: It is unfortunate that studying traffic flow is difficult, as the behavior of drivers cannot be predicted with certainty 100%.

source: 800 مایل از سیستم خط لوله ترانس-آلاسکا به دنبال انتشار هزاران بشکه نفت خام در جنوب فربنکس، آلاسکا بسته شد.
english_gold: 800 miles of the Trans-Alaska Pipeline System were closed down following a spill of thousands of barrels of crude oil south of Fairbanks, Alaska.
english_hypothesis: A 800-mile section of the Trans-Alaska Pipeline System was shut down after a spill of thousands of barrels of crude oil in the south of Fairbanks, Alaska.

source: قطع برق به دنبال یک آزمایش متداول سامانه فرماندهی آتش، باعث شد تا شیرهای اطمینان باز شوند و نفت خام در نزدیکی ایستگاه پمپ Fort Greely 9 سرریز شود.
english_gold: A power failure following a routine fire-command system test caused relief valves to open and crude oil overflowed near the Fort Greely pump station 9.
english_hypothesis: A power outage following a routine test of the Command and Control system caused the relief valves to open, resulting in a spill of crude oil near the Fort Greely Pump Station.

source: باز شدن دریچه‌ها موجب شد تا فشار سیستم تخلیه شود و روغن روی یک پد به سمت مخزن جاری شود، جایی که 55000 بشکه (2.3 میلیون گالن) ظرفیت وجود دارد.
english_gold: The valves opening allowed a pressure release for the system and oil flowed on a pad to a tank that can hold 55,000 barrels (2.3 million gallons).
english_hypothesis: The opening of the valves caused the system to decompress and oil to flow towards the tank, which has a capacity of 55,000 barrels (2.3 million gallons).

source: از بعدازظهر چهارشنبه، احتمالاً به دلیل انبساط حرارتی درون مخزن، دریچه‌های مخزن در حال نشت بود.
english_gold: As of Wednesday afternoon, the tank vents were still leaking probably from thermal expansion inside the tank.
english_hypothesis: Afternoon on Wednesday, possibly due to thermal expansion within the tank, the tank's valves were leaking.

source: یکی دیگر از مناطق مهار ثانویه در زیر مخازن است که گنجایش 104.500 بشکه را دارد اما هنوز ظرفیت آن پر نشده است.
english_gold: Another secondary containment area below the tanks capable of holding 104,500 barrels was not yet filled to capacity.
english_hypothesis: One of the secondary storage areas beneath the tanks, with a capacity of 104,500 barrels, remains underutilized.

source: هواپیمای اوتر دوموتوره دیروز سعی داشت با شماره پرواز CG4684 از خطوط هوایی Airlines PNG در کوکودا به زمین بنشیند، اما همان موقع هم یک بار ناموفق عمل کرده بود.
english_gold: The Twin Otter had been trying to land at Kokoda yesterday as Airlines PNG Flight CG4684, but had aborted once already.
english_hypothesis: The aircraft, a twin-engine Otter, attempted to land at Kokoda with flight number CG4684 operated by Airlines PNG, but had previously been unsuccessful in doing so.

source: حدود ده دقیقه قبل از زمانی که قرار بود برای بار دوم برای فرود تلاش کند ناپدید شد.
english_gold: About ten minutes before it was due to land from its second approach it disapeared.
english_hypothesis: About ten minutes before he was supposed to attempt landing for the second time, he vanished.

source: جستجو به دلیل همان هوای بد که منجر به فرود ناموفق شده بود، متوقف شد.
english_gold: The search had been hampered by the same bad weather that had caused the aborted landing.
english_hypothesis: The search was halted due to the same bad weather that had led to the unsuccessful landing.

source: امروز محل سقوط مشخص شد و این نقطه آنقدر غیرقابل دسترسی است که دو مامور پلیس در جنگل پیاده شدند تا به این محل صعود کنند و به دنبال بازماندگان بگردند.
english_gold: The crash site was located today and is so inaccessable that two policemen were dropped into the jungle in order to hike to the scene and seek survivors.
english_hypothesis: Today, the location of the crash was determined, and the point is so inaccessible that two police officers went into the forest on foot to ascend to the location and search for survivors.

source: براساس گزارش‌ها، یک آپارتمان در خیابان مکبث به دلیل نشت گاز منفجر شد.
english_gold: According to reports, an apartment on Macbeth Street exploded due to a gas leak.
english_hypothesis: A flat in Macbeth Street exploded due to a gas leak, according to reports.

source: پس از آنكه يكی از همسایه‌ها درباره نشت گاز تماس گرفت، يكی از مقام‌های شركت گاز در محل رویداد در حال ارائه گزارش بود.
english_gold: An official with the gas company was reporting to the scene after a neighbor called about a gas leak.
english_hypothesis: After one of the neighbors reported a gas leak, a representative from the gas company was on the scene providing a report.

source: وقتی مقام رسمی از راه رسید، آپارتمان منفجر شد.
english_gold: When the official arrived, the apartment exploded.
english_hypothesis: When the official arrived, my apartment exploded.

source: هیچ کس در آپارتمان حضور نداشت.
english_gold: No one was inside the apartment.
english_hypothesis: No one was present in the apartment.

source: هیچ مصدومیت عمده ای گزارش نشده است، اما حداقل پنج نفر در زمان انفجار در آن صحنه به دلیل علائم شوک تحت درمان قرار گرفتند.
english_gold: No major injuries were reported, but at least five people on scene at the time of the explosion were treated for symptoms of shock.
english_hypothesis: No major injuries have been reported, but at least five people were treated for shock symptoms at the scene of the explosion.

source: در آن موقع، تقریباً 100 نفر از ساکنان آن منطقه از آنجا بیرون برده شده بودند.
english_gold: At the time, nearly 100 residents were evacuated from the area.
english_hypothesis: At that time, almost 100 residents of that area had been taken out from there.

source: موتور سوار 13 ساله «پیتر لنز»‌ در یک تصادف در پیست موتورسواری ایندیاناپولیس کشته شده است.
english_gold: Peter Lenz, a 13-year-old motorcycle racer, has died after being involved in a crash at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway.
english_hypothesis: Peter Lenz, a 13-year-old motorcycle rider, was killed in a crash at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway.

source: در حالی که لنز مشغول گرم کردن خود بود، از روی دوچرخه‌اش افتاد و سپس با هم‌تیمی‌اش خاویر زایات مورد برخورد کرد.
english_gold: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.
english_hypothesis: While the lens was warming up, he fell off his bike and then collided with teammate Javier Zarraga.

source: کادر پزشکی حاضر فوراً او را تحت مراقبت قرار دادند و به یکی از بیمارستان‌های محل منتقل کردند، که بعداً در آنجا درگذشت.
english_gold: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.
english_hypothesis: The medical staff present immediately placed him under care and transferred him to one of the local hospitals, where he later passed away.

source: در تصادف زایات آسیب ندید.
english_gold: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.
english_hypothesis: You were not injured in the accident.

source: وقتی درگیری متوقف شد و زخمی‌ها به بیمارستان انتقال داده شدند، حدود 40 زندانی باقیمانده دیگر در حیاط ماندند و از بازگشت به سلول‌هایشان خودداری کردند.
english_gold: When the fighting ceased after the wounded were transported to the hospital, about 40 of the other remaining inmates stayed in the yard and refused to return to their cells.
english_hypothesis: When the fighting stopped and the wounded were taken to the hospital, about 40 remaining prisoners stayed in the courtyard and refused to return to their cells.

source: بین ساعت 10:00-11:00 بعد از ظهر به وقت MDT، آتشی توسط زندانیان در حیاط روشن شد.
english_gold: Between 10:00-11:00 pm MDT, a fire was started by the inmates in the yard.
english_hypothesis: Between 10:00 and 11:00 a.m. MDT, inmates lit a fire in the yard.

source: کمی بعد، افسرهای مجهز به تجهیزات ضد شورش وارد حیاط شدند و زندانی‌ها را با گاز اشک‌آور محدود کردند.
english_gold: Soon, officers equipped with riot gear entered the yard and cornered the inmates with tear gas.
english_hypothesis: A short while later, riot-equipped officers entered the courtyard and used tear gas to contain the prisoners.

source: خدمه گروه آتش‌نشانی و نجات سرانجام در ساعت 11:35 بعدازظهر آتش را خاموش کردند.
english_gold: Fire rescue crews eventually doused the fire by 11:35 pm.
english_hypothesis: The fire-fighting and rescue team finally extinguished the fire at 11:35 in the afternoon.

english_gold: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.
english_hypothesis: Turkey ranks 37th in the world in terms of size, and its area is almost equal to the combined area of metropolitan France and England.

source: ترکیه از سه طرف توسط دریا احاطه شده است: از غرب با دریای اژه، از شمال با دریای سیاه و از جنوب با دریای مدیترانه.
english_gold: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.
english_hypothesis: Turkey is surrounded by sea on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north, and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

source: جزایر کوک یک کشور جزیره‌ای در اتحاد آزاد با نیوزلند است، که در پولینزی، در میانه اقیانوس آرام جنوبی واقع شده است.
english_gold: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.
english_hypothesis: The Cook Islands are a self-governing island country in free association with New Zealand, located in the South Pacific Ocean, in Polynesia.

source: شبه‌جزیره‌ای است با 15 جزیره که تا بیش از 2.2 میلیون کیلومتر مربع در پهنه اقیانوس کشیده شده است.
english_gold: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.
english_hypothesis: This is an archipelago with 15 islands, stretching over an area of more than 2.2 million square kilometers across the ocean.

source: به این جزایر که منطقه زمانی‌شان با هاوایی یکسان است، گاهی نام «هاوایی پایین‌دست» را نسبت می‌دهند.
english_gold: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".
english_hypothesis: These islands, which are in the same time zone as Hawaii, are sometimes referred to as "Lower Hawaii."

source: شهری در جزایر کوک وجود ندارد، بلکه از 15 جزیره مختلف تشکیل شده است. جزایر اصلی عبارتند از راروتونگو و آیتوتاکی.
english_gold: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.
english_hypothesis: There is no city on the Cook Islands, but rather 15 separate islands. The main islands are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

source: قاره قطب جنوب سردترین مکان زمین است و قطب جنوب زمین را احاطه کرده است.
english_gold: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.
english_hypothesis: The Antarctic continent is the coldest place on Earth, and the South Pole encircles the Earth.

source: خشکی‌های قطب جنوب یک دشت خالی از سکنه است که با 2-3 کیلومتر یخ پوشانده شده است.
english_gold: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.
english_hypothesis: The Antarctic Plateau is a vast, uninhabited region covered by 2-3 kilometers of ice.

source: در تابستان حدود چند هزار کارمند در اینجا و در تقریباً‌ پنجاه پایگاه و اکثراً‌ در آن مناطق زندگی می‌کنند؛ تعداد کمی در طول زمستان می‌مانند.
english_gold: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.
english_hypothesis: In the summer, approximately several thousand employees live here and in almost fifty bases, mostly in those areas; only a few stay during the winter.

source: بزرگراه قطب جنوب یک مسیر 1600 کیلومتری از پایگاه مک‌موردو در دریای راس به سمت قطب است.
english_gold: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.
english_hypothesis: The Transantarctic Highway is a 1600-kilometer route from McMurdo Base in the Ross Sea to the South Pole.

source: رودخانه آمازون دومین رودخانه از نظر طول و بزرگترین رودخانه کره زمین است. مقدار آبی که این رودخانه با خود می‌برد 8 برابر بیشتر از دومین رودخانه بزرگ جهان است.
english_gold: The Amazon River is the second longest and the biggest river on Earth. It carries more than 8 times as much water as the second biggest river.
english_hypothesis: The Amazon River is the second-longest and largest river on Earth. The volume of water it carries is eight times more than the second-largest river in the world.

source: آمازون پهناورترین رودخانه روی کره زمین نیز هست، و در نقاطی عرض آن به شش مایل می‌رسد.
english_gold: The Amazon is also the widest river on Earth, at times six miles wide.
english_hypothesis: The Amazon River is the largest river on Earth, and in some places, its width reaches six miles.

source: بیست درصد کامل از آبی که از رودخانه‌های زمین به اقیانوسها می‌ریزد از رودخانه آمازون می‌آید.
english_gold: A full 20 percent of the water that pours out of the planet's rivers into the oceans comes from the Amazon.
english_hypothesis: Twenty percent of the total amount of water that flows from the rivers of the earth to the oceans comes from the Amazon River.

source: بستر اصلی رود آمازون 6387 کیلومتر (3980 مایل) است و آب هزاران رودخانه کوچک را جمع‌آوری می‌کند.
english_gold: The main Amazon River is 6,387 km (3,980 miles). It collects water from thousands of smaller rivers.
english_hypothesis: The Amazon River's main stem is 6,387 kilometers (3,980 miles) long and collects the waters of thousands of small rivers.

source: جزیره هنگ‌کنگ سبب نام‌گذاری سرزمین هنگ‌کنگ شده است و مکانی است که بسیاری از گردشگران آن را به عنوان تمرکز اصلی گردشگری خود در نظر می‌گیرند.
english_gold: Hong Kong Island gives the territory of Hong Kong its name and is the place that many tourists regard as the main focus.
english_hypothesis: The Hong Kong Island is the reason for the naming of the Hong Kong territory and a place where many tourists consider it as the main focus of their tourism.

source: بخش اعظمی از توسعه شهری جزیره هنگ‌کنگ در امتداد خط ساحل شمالی به‌صورت متراکم در زمین‌های اصلاح‌شده سکنی‌گزیده است.
english_gold: The great majority of Hong Kong Island's urban development is densely packed on reclaimed land along the northern shore.
english_hypothesis: A significant portion of Hong Kong's urban development is concentrated along the northern shoreline, where it has been built on reclaimed land.

source: جلوه ساختمانهایی که خط افق هنگ‌کنگ را تشکیل می‌دهند، همانند یک نمودار میله‌ای درخشان است که با حضور در کنار آب‌های بندر ویکتوریا آشکار می‌شوند.
english_gold: The parade of buildings that make the Hong Kong skyline has been likened to a glittering bar chart that is made apparent by the presence of the waters of Victoria Harbour.
english_hypothesis: The skyline of the buildings that form the Hong Kong horizon is like a shining bar chart that becomes apparent when viewed alongside the waters of Victoria Harbour.

source: برای داشتن بهترین نما از هنگ کنگ،‌ جزیره را ترک کنید و به سمت مقابل لب ساحل کاولون حرکت کنید.
english_gold: To get the best views of Hong Kong, leave the island and head for the Kowloon waterfront opposite.
english_hypothesis: To get the best view of Hong Kong, leave the island and head towards the opposite side of Kowloon's coastline.

source: سونداربانس بزرگترین کمربند یکپارچه درختان حرا در جهان است که 80 کیلومتر (50 مایل) امتداد دارد و از ساحل بنگلادش و هند به سمت مناطق داخلی کشیده شده است.
english_gold: The Sundarbans are the largest littoral mangrove belt in the world, stretching 80 km (50 mi) into the Bangladeshi and Indian hinterland from the coast.
english_hypothesis: The Sundarbans is the largest contiguous area of mangrove forest in the world, spanning 80 kilometers (50 miles) and stretching from the coast of Bangladesh and India into the interior.

source: «سانداربنس» سایت میراث جهانی یونسکو اعلام شده است. بخش جنگلی واقع در قلمرو هندوستان پارک جنگلی سانداربنس نامیده می‌شود.
english_gold: The Sundarbans has been declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The part of the forest within Indian territory is called Sundarbans National Park.
english_hypothesis: The Sundarbans site has been declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The forested area within the Sundarbans is known as the Sundarbans Forest in India.

source: محدوده سونداربانس حدود 3,850 کیلومتر مربع است و حدود یک سوم آن را آب/مرداب تشکیل داده است.
english_gold: The Sundarbans cover an area of 3,850 km², of which about one-third is covered in water/marsh areas.
english_hypothesis: The Sundarbans area is approximately 3,850 square kilometers in size, with about one-third of it being water/estuary.

source: این جنگل‌ها فقط باتلاق‌های کرنا نیست - بلکه برخی از آخرین باقی‌مانده‌های جنگل‌های انبوه را در خود جای داده‌اند که زمانی جلگه سند و گنگ را پوشانده بود.
english_gold: The forests aren't just mangrove swamps though — they include some of the last remaining stands of the mighty jungles which once covered the Gangetic plain.
english_hypothesis: These marshes are not just the marshes of Khorasan - they also contain some of the last remaining remnants of the dense forests that once covered the Sistan and Baluchestan plains.

source: ساندربانس از سال 1966 یک حفاظتگاه حیات وحش بوده است و تخمین زده شده که اکنون 400 ببر بنگال سلطنتی و حدود 30,000 گوزن در این منطقه دیده شده است.
english_gold: Since 1966 the Sundarbans have been a wildlife sanctuary, and it is estimated that there are now 400 Royal Bengal tigers and about 30,000 spotted deer in the area.
english_hypothesis: Sundarbans has been a wildlife sanctuary since 1966, and it is estimated that there are now approximately 400 Royal Bengal tigers and about 30,000 deer in this area.

source: بدلیل قرار گرفتن اوکلند بین دو بندرگاه، ساحل‌های بسیاری وجود دارند. محبوب‌ترین آنها در سه ناحیه قرار دارند.
english_gold: There are many beaches, due to Auckland's straddling of two harbours. The most popular ones are in three areas.
english_hypothesis: There are many beaches in Auckland because it is situated between two harbors. The most popular ones are located in three areas.

source: سواحل نورث شور (در منطقه نورث هاربر) در اقیانوس آرام است و از لانگ بی در شمال تا دونپورت در جنوب امتداد دارد.
english_gold: North Shore beaches (in North Harbour district) are on the Pacific Ocean and stretch from Long Bay in the north to Devonport in the south.
english_hypothesis: The shores of North Shore (in the North Harbour area) are in the Pacific Ocean and stretch from Long Bay in the north to Dunedin in the south.

source: آنها تقریباً همه سواحل شنی هستند که شنا در آنها ایمن است و اکثر آنها دارای سایه درختان پوهوتوکاوا است.
english_gold: They are almost all sandy beaches with safe swimming, and most have shade provided by pohutukawa trees.
english_hypothesis: They are almost all sandy beaches where swimming is safe and most of them have shade from the Pōhutukawa trees.

source: سواحل تاماکی درایو در بندر وایتماتا، در حومه شهرهای معروف میشن بی و سنت هلییرز در اوکلند مرکزی قرار دارند.
english_gold: Tamaki Drive beaches are on the Waitemata Harbour, in the upmarket suburbs of Mission Bay and St Heliers in Central Auckland.
english_hypothesis: The Tamaki Drive waterfront in Auckland, New Zealand, is located in the suburbs of the well-known cities of Mission Bay and St. Heliers.

source: سانسکریت یک زبان باستانی است و قابل مقایسه است با زبان لاتین که در اروپا صحبت می شود.
english_gold: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.
english_hypothesis: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to Latin, which is spoken in Europe.

source: نظریه‌های بسیاری درباره نحوه بوجود آمدن سانسکریت وجود دارد. یکی از آنها درباره مهاجرت یک آریایی از غرب به هندوستان است که زبانش را به آنجا آورد.
english_gold: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.
english_hypothesis: There are many theories about the origin of Sanskrit. One of them is about the migration of an Aryan from the West to India, who brought his language with him.

source: اولین کتاب شناخته شده جهان به زبان سانسکریت نوشته شده است. پس از تدوین اوپانیشاد، سانسکریت به‌دلیل سلسله مراتبش محو شد.
english_gold: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.
english_hypothesis: The first known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of the Upanishads, Sanskrit became obscure due to its complex structure.

source: سانسکریت زبانی بسیار پیچیده و غنی است که به‌عنوان منشاء بسیاری از زبان‌های هندی مدرن عمل کرده است، درست مثل لاتین که منشاء زبان‌های اروپایی مثل فرانسه و اسپانیایی است.
english_gold: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.
english_hypothesis: Sanskrit is a highly complex and rich language that has served as the source for many modern Indian languages, just as Latin has been the source for European languages such as French and Spanish.

source: در حدود قرن 15، شمال استونی به شدت تحت تأثیر فرهنگ آلمان قرار داشت.
english_gold: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.
english_hypothesis: In the 15th century, northern Estonia was heavily influenced by German culture.

source: برخی از راهبان آلمانی می خواستند خدا را به مردم بومی نزدیک‌تر کنند، بنابراین آنها زبان تحت لفظی استونی را اختراع کردند.
english_gold: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.
english_hypothesis: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the local people, so they invented the Estonian language.

source: این کار بر اساس الفبای آلمانی بود و یک نویسه «Õ/õ» اضافه شد.
english_gold: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.
english_hypothesis: This work was based on the German alphabet and an additional character "Õ/õ" was added.

source: با گذشت زمان، بسیاری از وام‌واژه‌های برگرفته از آلمانی تلفیق شدند. این رخداد شروع روشنگری بود.
english_gold: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.
english_hypothesis: With the passage of time, many loanwords derived from German were assimilated. This event marked the beginning of enlightenment.

source: مکتب سیک مذهبی با منشأ شبه‌قاره هند است. این مذهب طی قرن پانزدهم از یکی از فرقه‌های سنت هندو در منطقه پنجاب سرچشمه گرفته است.
english_gold: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.
english_hypothesis: The Sikh religion originated in the Indian subcontinent. It emerged in the 15th century from one of the sects of Hinduism in the Punjab region.

source: پیروان سیک دینشان را جدای از هندوئیسم می‌دانند، گرچه اذعان می‌کنند که ریشه و سنت در هندو دارد.
english_gold: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.
english_hypothesis: Followers of Sikhism consider their religion separate from Hinduism, although they acknowledge that its roots and traditions are rooted in Hinduism.

source: سیک‌ها دین خود را Gurmat می‌نامند که واژه پنجابی به معنای «روش گورو» است. گورو یک وجه بنیادی از تمام ادیان هندی است ولی آیین سیک اهمیت آن را به حدی رسانده که هسته اعتقادات سیک را تشکیل می‌دهد.
english_gold: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.
english_hypothesis: The Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is a Punjabi word meaning "the method of the Guru." The Guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions, but Sikhism has elevated its importance to the point where it forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

source: این آیین در قرن پانزدهم به دست گورو ناناک (1539- 1469) ایجاد شد. پس از آن، نه مبلغ مذهبی دیگر هم یکی پس از دیگری آمدند.
english_gold: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.
english_hypothesis: This faith was created by Guru Nanak in the 15th century (1539-1469). After him, no other religious figure came.

source: ماهیت نظامی‌گرای امپراتوری روم به توسعه پیشرفت‌های پزشکی کمک کرد.
english_gold: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.
english_hypothesis: The military nature of the Roman Empire contributed to the development of medical advancements.

source: امپراتور آگوستوس شروع به استخدام پزشکان کرد و حتی نخستین سپاه پزشکان رومی را برای بکارگیری پس از نبردها تشکیل داد.
english_gold: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.
english_hypothesis: Emperor Augustus began to hire physicians and even formed the first Roman legion of physicians for deployment after battles.

source: جراح‌ها از آرام‌بخش‌های متنوع از جمله مرفین که از عصاره دانه‌های خشخاش گرفته می‌شود و اسکوپولامین که از بنگ‌دانه گرفته می‌شود اطلاع داشتند.
english_gold: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.
english_hypothesis: They were aware of various sedatives, including morphine, which is derived from opium poppy seeds, and scopolamine, which is derived from the datura plant.

source: آنها برای نجات بیماران مبتلا به قانقاریا در قطع عضو و نیز برای جلوگیری از جریان خون در استفاده از تورنیکت‌ها و شریان‌بندها ماهر شدند.
english_gold: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.
english_hypothesis: They have become skilled in amputating limbs to save patients suffering from gangrene, and in using tourniquets and ligatures to stop the flow of blood.

source: طی قرن‌های بسیار، امپراتوری روم به دستاوردهای بزرگی در زمینه پزشکی رسید و بخش اعظمی از دانش امروزی ما را شکل داد.
english_gold: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.
english_hypothesis: The Roman Empire achieved great accomplishments in the field of medicine over many centuries and shaped a significant portion of our modern knowledge.

source: برای مدت‌ها در قرون نوزدهم و بیستم اعتقاد می‌رفت اولین ساکنان نیوزلند مردم مائوری باشند که پرندگان غول‌آسایی به‌نام مواس شکار می‌کردند.
english_gold: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.
english_hypothesis: For many years, it was believed that the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Māori people, who hunted giant birds known as Moa.

source: این نظریه سپس سبب ایده‌ای شد که مردم مائوری از پلی‌نزی با یک ناوگان بزرگ مهاجرت کردند و نیوزلند را با تشکیل یک جامعه کشاوری از موریوری گرفتند.
english_gold: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.
english_hypothesis: This theory then led to the idea that the Maori people of Polynesia migrated to New Zealand with a large fleet and established a seafaring society.

source: با وجود این، شواهد جدید پیشنهاد می‌دهد که «موریوری» یک گروه از «مائوری» های سرزمین اصلی بودند که از نیوزلند به جزایر چاتام مهاجرت کرده و فرهنگ مجزا و صلح‌آمیز خودشان را گسترش دادند.
english_gold: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.
english_hypothesis: Despite this, new evidence suggests that the "Moriori" were a subgroup of the "Maori" who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands and developed their own distinct and peaceful culture.

source: قبیله دیگری نیز در جزایر چاتهام وجود داشت که اینها مائوری بودند که از نیوزیلند مهاجرت کردخه‌اند.
english_gold: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.
english_hypothesis: There was another tribe in the Chatham Islands, the Maori, who had migrated from New Zealand.

source: آنها خود را موریوری می نامیدند، درگیری‌هایی رخ داد و در پایان، موریوری از بین رفت
english_gold: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out
english_hypothesis: They called themselves Mauyori, conflicts arose, and in the end, Mauyori was eradicated.

source: یک تمدن یک فرهنگ واحد است که توسط گروه بسیار بزرگی از مردم، یک جامعه، که در کنار هم زندگی و کار می‌کنند رعایت می‌شود.
english_gold: A civilization is a singular culture shared by a significant large group of people who live and work co-operatively, a society.
english_hypothesis: A civilization is a single culture that is observed by a very large group of people, a society, who live and work together.

source: واژه‌ی civilization از واژه‌ی Latin civilis، به معنای مدنی مشتق می‌شود که مربوط به واژه لاتین civis است، به معنای شهرنشین، و civitas، به معنای شهری، و تاحدودی اندازه جامعه را نیز تعریف می‌کند.
