source: این صحنه‌ها روی اهرام نمایش داده می‌شود و اهرام مختلف روشن می‌شوند.
english_gold: The scenes are displayed on the pyramids and the different pyramids are lit up.
english_hypothesis: These scenes are projected onto the pyramids and the pyramids are illuminated.

source: از زیردریایی‌ها در جنگ جهانی اول و دوم استفاده می‌شد. آن موقع سرعتشان خیلی کم و بُرد تیراندازی‌شان بسیار محدود بود.
english_gold: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.
english_hypothesis: Submarines were used in World War I and II. At that time, their speed was very slow and their range was very limited.

source: در آغاز جنگ، زیردریایی‌ها بیشتر روی آب دریا حرکت می‌کردند، اما با بکارگیری رادار و دقیق‌تر شدن آن، آنها محبور شدند برای دیده نشدن، به زیر آب بروند.
english_gold: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.
english_hypothesis: At the beginning of the war, submarines mostly operated on the surface of the sea, but with the use of radar and its increasing accuracy, they were forced to dive underwater to remain undetected.

source: زیردریایی‌های آلمانی یو-بوت نام داشتند. آلمان‌ها در ناوبری و کار با زیردریایی‌هایشان بسیار ماهر بودند.
english_gold: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.
english_hypothesis: German U-boats were called Unterseebooten. The Germans were highly skilled in navigation and operating their submarines.

source: به دلیل موفقیت آنها در مورد زیردریایی‌ها، پس از جنگ به آلمانی‌ها اعتماد نمی‌شود تا بسیاری از آن‌ها را داشته باشند.
english_gold: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.
english_hypothesis: They do not trust the Germans to have many of them after the war due to their success with submarines.

source: جمهوری دومینیکن (اسپانیایی: República Dominicana) یک کشور در جزائر کارائیب است که در نیمه شرقی جزیره هیسپانیولا در کنار هائیتی واقع است.
english_gold: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti
english_hypothesis: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a country in the Caribbean islands, located in the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, bordering Haiti.

source: در این جزیره ابتدا تائینوها و کاریب‌ها سکونت داشتند. کاریب‌ها مردمانی آراواک زبان بودند که حدود 10,000 سال قبل از گاه‌شماری مشترک وارد شده بودند.
english_gold: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.
english_hypothesis: The Taíno and Carib peoples were the first inhabitants of this island. The Caribs were an Arawakan-speaking people who arrived around 10,000 years before the Common Era.

source: طی سال‌های اندکی پس از رسیدن سیاحان اروپایی، جمعیت تائینوها به طور قابل ملاحظه‌ای توسط فاتحان اسپانیایی کاهش داده شد.
english_gold: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors
english_hypothesis: The Taino population was significantly reduced by Spanish conquistadors shortly after the arrival of European tourists.

source: بر اساس Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) بین سال‌های 1492 و 1498 فاتحان اسپانیایی حدود 100,000 از تائینو‌ها را کشتند.
english_gold: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.
english_hypothesis: Between 1492 and 1498, Spanish conquerors killed approximately 100,000 Taino people, as stated in Fray Bartolomé de las Casas' "Tratado de las Indias".

source: در سال 1624، کمپانی Dutch East India پایگاهی را در جنوب غربی تایوان تأسیس می‌کند، که آغازگر یک دگرگونی در عملیات تولید غلات بومی است و کارگران چینی را برای کار در مزارع شکر و برنج خود بکار می‌گیرد.
english_gold: In 1624,Dutch East India Company establishes a base in southwestern Taiwan, initiating a transformation in aboriginal grain production practices and employing Chinese laborers to work on its rice and sugar plantations.
english_hypothesis: In 1624, the Dutch East India Company establishes a base in southwestern Taiwan, marking the beginning of a transformation in the production of native grains and employing Chinese laborers to work in their sugar and rice fields.

source: در سال 1683، سلسله چینگ (1644-1912) کنترل نواحی غربی و شمالی تایوان را به زور در دست گرفت و در سال 1885 تایوان را به‌عنوان یکی از استان‌های امپراطوری چینگ اعلام کرد.
english_gold: In 1683, Qing dynasty (1644-1912) forces take control of Taiwan’s western and northern coastal areas and declared Taiwan as a province of the Qing Empire in 1885.
english_hypothesis: In 1683, the Qing dynasty (1644-1912) seized control of western and northern Taiwan by force and in 1885, Taiwan was declared one of the provinces of the Qing Empire.

source: در سال 1895، دولت چینگ پس از شکست در اولین جنگ چین و ژاپن (1894 تا 1895) قرارداد شیمونوسکی را امضا کرد که طبق آن حاکمیت تایوان به ژاپن واگذار شد و ژاپن تا سال 1945 این جزیره را تحت سلطه خود داشت.
english_gold: In 1895, after defeat in the First Sino-Japanese War (1894-1895), the Qing government signs the Treaty of Shimonoseki, by which it cedes sovereignty over Taiwan to Japan, which rules the island until 1945.
english_hypothesis: In 1895, the Qing government, following its defeat in the First Sino-Japanese War (1894-1895), signed the Treaty of Shimonoseki, which ceded Taiwan to Japan. Japan controlled the island until 1945.

source: شروع تایوان به قرن 15ام بر می‌گردد، آن زمان که ملوانان اروپایی که از آنجا می‌گذشتند نام جزیره را «Ilha Formosa» یا جزیره زیبا نامیدند.
english_gold: Taiwan beginning start way back in 15th century where European sailors passing by record the island’s name as Ilha Formosa, or beautiful island.
english_hypothesis: Taiwan's history dates back to the 15th century, when European sailors passing through the area named the island "Ilha Formosa" or "Beautiful Island".

source: چین باستان روش منحصربه‌فردی برای نشان دادن دوره‌های زمانی مختلف داشت؛ هر دوره زمانی از چین یا هر خانواده که قدرت را در دست داشت یک سلسله متمایز بود.
english_gold: Ancient China had a unique way of showing different time periods; each stage of China or each family that was in power was a distinctive dynasty.
english_hypothesis: China in ancient times had a unique method of indicating different time periods; each time period was a distinct dynasty, either from China or from any ruling family.

source: همچنین بین هر سلسله، یک عصر ناپایدار وجود داشت که استانها تقسیم می‌شدند. معروف‌ترین دوره، دوران سه پادشاهی بود که به مدت 60 سال بین‌ سلسله هان و جین اتفاق افتاد.
english_gold: Also between each dynasty was an unstable age of divided provinces. The best-known of these periods was the Three Kingdoms epoch taking place for 60 years between the Han and the Jin Dynasty.
english_hypothesis: In addition, between each dynasty, there was a period of instability that lasted for 60 years, during which the provinces were divided. The most famous period was the Three Kingdoms era, which occurred between the Han and Jin dynasties.

source: در این دوران، جنگ‌های شدیدی بین بسیاری از اشراف که برای تاج و تخت می‌جنگیدند، صورت گرفت.
english_gold: During these periods fierce warfare took place between many nobles fighting for the throne.
english_hypothesis: In this era, fierce wars took place among many nobles who fought for the crown and the throne.

source: این سه پادشاهی یکی از خونین‌ترین دوران تاریخ چین باستان به حساب می‌آید که در آن هزاران نفر برای تصاحب بالاترین کرسی در کاخ بزرگ در شی‌آن جان خود را از دست دادند.
english_gold: The Three Kingdoms was one of the bloodiest eras in Ancient China’s history thousands of people died fighting to sit in the highest seat in the grand palace at Xi’an.
english_hypothesis: This period is considered one of the bloodiest in ancient Chinese history, with thousands of people losing their lives in the struggle for the highest seat in the imperial court in Xi'an.

source: غذاهای روم باستان نمی‌تواند غذاهایی که در قرن‌های بعد از آمریکا و آسیا آورده می‌شد را شامل شده باشد.
english_gold: Ancient Roman meals couldn't have included foods that came to Europe from America or from Asia in later centuries.
english_hypothesis: The cuisine of ancient Rome cannot include the dishes brought from America and Asia in the centuries that followed.

source: به عنوان مثال، آنها نه ذرت داشتند، نه گوجه فرنگی، نه سیب زمینی، نه کاکائو، و هیچ رومی باستان هرگز طعم بوقلمون را نچشیده بود.
english_gold: For instance, they didn't have corn, nor tomatoes, nor potatoes, nor cocoa, and no ancient Roman ever tasted a turkey.
english_hypothesis: They had no corn, no tomatoes, no potatoes, no cocoa, and no ancient Romans had ever tasted the flavor of pork.

source: در حالی که بیشتر غذاهای آنها برای ما آشنا خواهد بود، رومی ها سهم خود را از وسایل عجیب و غریب و غیر معمولی از جمله گراز وحشی، طاووس، حلزون و گونه ای از جوندگان بنام موش زمستان خواب در اختیار داشتند.
english_gold: While most of their food would be familiar to us, Romans did have their share of strange or unusual feast items, including wild boar, peacock, snails, and a type of rodent called a dormouse
english_hypothesis: While most of their foods will be familiar to us, the Romans had their share of exotic and unusual items, including wild boar, peacock, snails, and a type of rodent known as the dormouse.

source: تفاوت دیگر از این قرار بود که وقتی افراد فقیر و زن‌ها روی صندلی خود می‌نشستند و غذای خود را می‌خوردند، مردان ثروتمند دوست داشتند ضیافت‌هایی را در کنار هم برگزار کنند و در حین خوردن وعده‌های غذایی‌شان در کنار هم خوش بگذرانند.
english_gold: Another difference was that while the poor people and the woman ate their food while sitting in chairs, the rich men liked to have banquets together where they would lounge on their sides while they ate their meals.
english_hypothesis: The difference was that when poor people and women sat on their chairs and ate their food, wealthy men enjoyed hosting gatherings together and spending time together while eating their meals.

source: شرایط آب‌و‌هوایی سخت اصطلاح کلی برای پدیده آب و هوایی خطرناکی است که احتمال وارد آوردن خسارت و مختل کردن زندگی اجتماعی را دارد یا سبب از دست رفتن زندگی انسا‌ن‌ها می‌شود.
english_gold: Severe weather is the generic term for any dangerous weather phenomenon with the potential to cause damage, serious social disruption, or loss of human life.
english_hypothesis: The term "sensitive weather conditions" is a general term for a hazardous weather phenomenon that has the potential to cause damage and disrupt social life, or even result in loss of human life.

source: آب و هوای خشک می تواند در هر نقطه از جهان رخ دهد، و انواع مختلفی از آن وجود دارد، که می تواند به جغرافیا، توپوگرافی و شرایط جوی بستگی داشته باشد.
english_gold: Severe weather can occur anywhere in the world, and there are different types of it, which can depend on geography, topography, and atmospheric conditions.
english_hypothesis: Dry weather can occur anywhere in the world and comes in various forms, which can depend on geography, topography, and weather conditions.

source: وزش باد شدید، تگرگ، بارندگی بیش از حد و آتش‌سوزی و همچنین رعد و برق، گردباد، آبشارها و طوفانهای موسمی همه از اشکال و تأثیرات هوای شدید است.
english_gold: High winds, hail, excessive precipitation, and wildfires are forms and effects of severe weather, as are thunderstorms, tornadoes, waterspouts, and cyclones.
english_hypothesis: Severe wind, hail, excessive rainfall, wildfires, thunderstorms, tornadoes, waterfalls, and monsoon storms are all forms and effects of severe weather.

source: پدیده‌های شدید آب و هوایی منطقه‌ای و فصلی شامل کولاک، طوفان برف، طوفان یخ و طوفان گرد و غبار است.
english_gold: Regional and seasonal severe weather phenomena include blizzards, snowstorms, ice storms, and dust storms.
english_hypothesis: Severe weather phenomena in the region and seasonal include hail, snowstorms, ice storms, and dust storms.

source: چنین معتقدند که این پنجمین بار در تاریخ است که مردم شاهد ماده‌ای هستند که از نظر شیمیایی تایید شده متعلق به مریخ بوده و روی زمین سقوط کرده است.
english_gold: This is believed to be the fifth time in history that people have observed what turned out to be chemically confirmed martian material falling to Earth.
english_hypothesis: They believe this is the fifth time in history that people have witnessed a substance chemically confirmed to be from Mars that has fallen to Earth.

source: از حدود 24000 شهاب سنگ شناخته شده که در زمین سقوط کرده‌اند، تنها مبدأ حدود 34 عدد تائید شده که از مریخ بوده است.
english_gold: Out of the approximately 24,000 known meteorites to have fallen to Earth, only about 34 have been verified to be martian in origin.
english_hypothesis: From about 24,000 known meteorites that have fallen to Earth, only about 34 have been confirmed to have originated from Mars.

source: پانزده تا از این سنگ‌ها مربوط به باران شهاب سنگ در جولای گذشته است.
english_gold: Fifteen of these rocks are attributed to the meteorite shower last July.
english_hypothesis: Fifteen of these rocks are from the meteor shower in July last year.

source: برخی از این سنگ‌ها که در کره زمین خیلی نادر هستند با قیمت از 11,000 تا 22,500 دلار در هر اونس فروخته می‌شوند که چیزی حدود ده برابر قیمت طلا است.
english_gold: Some of the rocks, which are very rare on Earth, are being sold from US$11,000 to $22,500 per ounce, which is about ten times more than the cost of gold.
english_hypothesis: Some of these stones, which are very rare on Earth, are sold for $11,000 to $22,500 per ounce, which is approximately ten times the price of gold.

source: هزاران سال پیش، مردی به نام آریستارخوس گفت که منظومه شمسی به دور خورشید حرکت می کند.
english_gold: Thousands of years ago, a man called Aristarchus said that the Solar System moved around the Sun.
english_hypothesis: Aristarchus of Samos, a Greek mathematician and astronomer, proposed the first known heliocentric model of the solar system around 250 BCE.

source: این منطقی به نظر می‌رسد، زیرا روی زمین احساس نمی کنید که در حال حرکت هستید،اینطور نیست؟
english_gold: This seems sensible, because the Earth doesn't feel as if it's moving, does it?
english_hypothesis: This seems logical, as you don't feel like you are moving on the ground, right?

source: حدود سه هزار سال بعد، در 1610، ستاره‌شناس ایتالیایی گالیلئو گالیله با استفاده از یک تلسکوپ متوجه شد سیاره زهره دقیقاً مانند ماه، دارای قمرهایی است.
english_gold: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.
english_hypothesis: In about 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei, using a telescope, discovered that the planet Venus, just like the Moon, has moons.

source: نمودها صورت می‌گیرند زیرا فقط طرف زهره (یا ماه) که طرف خورشید است روشن می‌شود. نمودهای زهره از نظریه کوپرنیک حمایت می‌کند مبنی براینکه سیارات دور خورشید می‌گردند.
english_gold: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.
english_hypothesis: Phases appear because only the side of Venus (or the Moon) facing the Sun is illuminated. The phases of Venus support the Copernican theory that planets orbit the Sun.

source: سپس چند سال بعد در 1639، یک منجم انگلیسی به نام «جرمایا هاروکس» یک گذر زهره را مشاهده کرد.
english_gold: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.
english_hypothesis: Then, several years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

source: هومینیدها برخلاف سایر نخستی‌سانان دیگر از دست‌هایشان در جابجایی یا تحمل وزن یا پریدن از درختی به درخت دیگر استفاده نمی‌کنند.
english_gold: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.
english_hypothesis: Hominids, unlike other primates, do not use their hands for moving, supporting weight, or jumping from one tree to another.

source: دست و پای شامپانزه از نظر اندازه و طول یکسان هستند و بیانگر استفاده از دست برای تحمل وزن و مشت‌پیمایی است.
english_gold: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.
english_hypothesis: The hands and feet of a chimpanzee are of equal size and length, indicating the use of hands for supporting weight and grasping.

source: دست انسان کوتاه‌تر از پایش است و استخوان‌های بند انگشت صاف‌تری دارد.
english_gold: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.
english_hypothesis: The human hand is shorter than the foot, and the metacarpal bones are smoother.

source: استخوان‌های دست فسیلی با قدمت دو میلیون تا سه میلیون سال تغییر تخصص دست را حرکتی به دستکاری را نشان می دهد.
english_gold: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.
english_hypothesis: The fossilized bones of the hand, dating back two to three million years, demonstrate a shift in hand dexterity from manipulation to movement.

source: افرادی که چندین دهه دخیل بودند به ما کمک کردند ضمن انجام ارزیابی صادقانه‌ای روی دشواری‌ها و حتی شکست‌ها، به نقاط قوت و علایق‌مان پی ببریم.
english_gold: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.
english_hypothesis: Individuals who were involved for several decades helped us to identify our strengths and interests, despite the challenges and even failures, through a sincere assessment.

source: افراد و کل اشخاص دخیل طی ارزیابی کامیابی‌ها و آگاهی از شکست‌ها، بیشتر به عمق ارزش‌ها، رسالت و نیروهای محرک سازمان پی می‌برند.
english_gold: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.
english_hypothesis: Individuals and all parties involved, through the assessment of successes and awareness of failures, come to understand the depth of the organization's values, mission, and driving forces.

source: در این نمونه، به‌یادآوری نمونه‌های قبلی رفتار کارآفرینانه و موفقیت‌های حاصله به افراد کمک کرد نسبت به تغییرات جدید و مسیر جدید کلیسای محلی روی باز نشان دهند.
english_gold: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.
english_hypothesis: In this instance, recalling previous entrepreneurial behavior and the successes that ensued helped individuals to be receptive to the changes and the new direction of the local church.

source: چنین داستان‌های موفقیت‌آمیزی ترس از تغییر را کاهش داد و تمایل مثبت برای ایجاد تغییر در آینده را موجب می‌شود.
english_gold: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.
english_hypothesis: This kind of successful story reduces the fear of change and encourages a positive inclination towards creating change in the future.

source: تحقیقات قرن بیستم نشان داد که دو منبع تغییرات ژنتیکی وجود دارد: پنهان و بیان شده.
english_gold: Twentieth century research has shown that there are two pools of genetic variation: hidden and expressed.
english_hypothesis: Research in the 20th century revealed that there are two sources of genetic variation: hidden and expressed.

source: جهش تنوع ژنتیکی جدید می‌افزاید و انتخاب آن را از خزانه تنوع بیان‌شده خارج می‌کند.
english_gold: Mutation adds new genetic variation, and selection removes it from the pool of expressed variation.
english_hypothesis: This sentence translates to: "The jump in new genetic diversity adds to it and takes it out of the bank of expressed diversity."

source: تفکیک و ترکیب مجدد اختلاف بین دو استخر با هر نسل را به سمت جلو و عقب بر می‌زند.
english_gold: Segregation and recombination shuffle variation back and forth between the two pools with each generation.
english_hypothesis: This sentence translates to: "The separation and recombination of differences between two pools pushes the system forward and backward with each generation."

source: جهش می‌تواند تأثیرات بسیار متفاوتی داشته باشد که بستگی دارد به نوع جهش، اهمیت قطعه ماده ژنتیکی تحت تأثیر، و اینکه آیا سلولهای درگیر سلولهای ژرم لاین هستند یا نه.
english_gold: Mutations can have a variety of different effects depending on the type of mutation, the significance of the piece of genetic material affected and whether the cells affected are germ-line cells.
english_hypothesis: Mutation can have very different effects, depending on the type of mutation, the importance of the affected genetic material, and whether the involved cells are germ cells or not.

source: تنها جهش در سلول‌های مشابه میکروبی می‌تواند به کودکان منتقل شود، درحالیکه جهش در جاهای دیگر می‌تواند باعث مرگ سلول یا سرطان شود.

source: در خارج از ساوانا، برآورده کردن نيازهاي مبتنی بر اسيد آمینه از منابع گياهي موجود برای یک نخستی که دستگاه گوارشی مشابه انسان داشته، کار دشواری بوده است.

source: از این گذشته، عدم انجام این امر عواقب جدی دارد: افسردگی رشد، سوء تغذیه و در نهایت مرگ.

source: در مقابل، غذاهای حیوانی (مورچه‌ها، موریانه‌ها‌، تخم‌ها) نه تنها به راحتی قابل هضم هستند بلکه پروتئین‌های با کیفیت بالا در اختیار می‌دهند که حاوی تمام اسیدهای آمینه ضروری است.

source: همه چیز در نظر گرفته شده است، و اگر اجداد خودمان «مشکل پروتئین» خود را تقریباً به همان شیوه‌ای حل کرده‌اند که امروزه شامپانزه‌ها در ساوانا انجام می‌دهند، نباید تعجب کنیم.

english_gold: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.
english_hypothesis: This allows students to work at their own pace and control the speed of the educational content.

source: به‌علاوه، محدودیت زمانی کمتری وجود دارد و ضمناً امکان ساعات کاری منعطف برقرار است. (برمر، 1998)
english_gold: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)
english_hypothesis: In addition, there is less time constraint and also the possibility of flexible working hours.

source: استفاده از اینترنت و شبکه جهانی وب به زبان‌آموزان اجازه می‌دهد همیشه به اطلاعات دسترسی داشته باشند.
english_gold: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.
english_hypothesis: Access to the internet and the World Wide Web gives language learners constant access to information.

source: دانشجویان می‌توانند در عوض اینکه تا جلسه حضوری بعدی منتظر بمانند، سؤالاتشان را نیز در هر زمانی از روز ارائه دهند و در حد معقول انتظار پاسخ سریع داشته باشند.
english_gold: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.
english_hypothesis: Students can submit their questions at any time of the day instead of waiting until the next in-person meeting, and reasonably expect a prompt response.

source: اپلیکیشن‌های مترجم متن آنی – برنامه هایی که قادر به ترجمه خودکار کل بخشهای متن از یک زبان به زبان دیگر هستند.
english_gold: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.
english_hypothesis: Text translation applications – programs that can automatically translate entire text sections from one language to another.

source: برخی از این برنامه‌های کاربردی در این دسته می‌توانند حتی متن‌هایی در زبان‌های خارجی را که روی علائم یا سایر اشیاء در دنیای واقعی قرار دارند را هنگامیکه کاربر گوشی هوشمند را به طرف آنها می‌گیرد ترجمه کنند.
english_gold: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.
english_hypothesis: Some of these apps in this category can even translate text in foreign languages that are placed on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points their smartphone at them.

source: موتورهای ترجمه به طرز چشمگیری بهبود یافته اند، و اکنون اغلب ترجمه های کم و بیش صحیحی (و به ندرت نامفهوم) ارائه می دهند، از آنجا که هنوز هم ممکن است کلا منظور را اشتباه درک کنند، نیاز به کمی مراقبت دارند.
english_gold: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.
english_hypothesis: Machine translation engines have significantly improved, and now often provide translations that are mostly accurate (and occasionally incomprehensible) as they still may not fully grasp the intended meaning, so they require a bit of care.

source: یکی از برجسته‌ترین برنامه‌ها در این دسته‌بندی Google Translate می‌باشد که پس از دانلود داده‌های زبان دلخواه امکان ترجمه آفلاین را فراهم می‌کند.
english_gold: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.
english_hypothesis: Google Translate is one of the most prominent programs in this category, which, after downloading the desired language data, provides offline translation capabilities.

source: گرچه یادگیری مبتنی بر پروژه باید یادگیری را آسان‌تر و جالب‌تر کند، سکوب‌بندی یک گام از آن فراتر می‌رود.
english_gold: While project based learning should make learning easier and more interesting, scaffolding goes a step beyond.
english_hypothesis: While project-based learning should make learning easier and more engaging, gamification takes it a step further.

source: داربست سازی روشی برای یادگیری نیست بلکه کمکی است که از افرادی که در حال دریافت یک تجربه یادگیری جدید مانند استفاده از یک برنامه جدید کامپیوتری یا شروع یک پروژه جدید هستند، پشتیبانی می کند.
english_gold: Scaffolding is not a method of learning but rather an aid that provides support to individuals whom are undergoing a new learning experience such as using a new computer program or beginning a new project.
english_hypothesis: Darbost-sazi is not a method for learning, but rather a support that helps individuals who are in the process of acquiring a new learning experience, such as using a new computer program or starting a new project.

source: داربست‌ها ممکن است مجازی یا واقعی باشند،‌ به عبارت دیگر یک معلم نوعی از داربست است ولی گیره کاغذ کوچک در Microsoft Office نیز داربست است.
english_gold: Scaffolds can be both virtual and real, in other words, a teacher is a form of scaffold but so is the little paperclip man in Microsoft Office.
english_hypothesis: Clips can be virtual or real, to put it another way, a teacher is a kind of clip, but a small paper clip in Microsoft Office is also a clip.

source: داربست های مجازی در نرم افزار درونی شده اند و هدف آن پرسش، برانگیختن و توضیح روش هایی است که ممکن است انجام آن به تنهایی برای دانشجویان چالش محسوب می‌شود.
english_gold: Virtual Scaffolds are internalized in the software and are meant to question, prompt, and explain procedures that may have been to challenging for the student to handle alone.
english_hypothesis: The virtual frameworks have been integrated into the software, and its purpose is to inquire, stimulate, and explain methods that may pose a challenge for students to perform independently.

source: تیم‌های مجازی هم همان معیارهای تعالی تیم‌های معمولی برایشان اعمال می‌شود، اما تفاوت‌های جزئی در آنها هست.
english_gold: Virtual teams are held to the same standards of excellence as conventional teams, but there are subtle differences.
english_hypothesis: Virtual teams are subject to the same standards of excellence as regular teams, but they have some minor differences.

source: اعضای تیم مجازی اغلب به عنوان نقطه تماس برای گروه فیزیکی مجاورشان عمل می‌کنند.
english_gold: Virtual team members often function as the point of contact for their immediate physical group.
english_hypothesis: Members of the virtual team often serve as a point of contact for the adjacent physical group.

source: آنها اغلب خود‌مختاری بیشتری نسبت به اعضای تیم قراردادی دارند چون تیم‌های آنها می‌توانند براساس مناطق زمانی مختلف تشکیل جلسه دهند ولی ممکن است مدیریت محلی‌شان این مناطق زمانی را متوجه نشود.
english_gold: They often have more autonomy than conventional team members as their teams may meet according to varying time zones which may not be understood by their local management.
english_hypothesis: They often have more autonomy than contract team members because their teams can hold meetings based on different time zones, but their local management may not be aware of these time zone differences.

source: حضور یک «تیم نامرئی» واقعی (لارسون و لافاستو، 1989، صفحه 109) همچنین یک مؤلفه منحصر به فرد یک از یک تیم مجازی است.
english_gold: The presence of a true “invisible team” (Larson and LaFasto, 1989, p109) is also a unique component of a virtual team.
english_hypothesis: The presence of a "ghost team" is a real phenomenon (Larson and LaFasto, 1989, p. 109) and is also a unique component of a virtual team.

source: چرا یک سازمان می‌خواهد وارد فرآیند زمان‌بر تأسیس یک سازمان آموزشی شود؟ یکی از اهداف به اجرا درآوردن مفاهیم یادگیری سازمانی نوآوری است.
english_gold: Why would an organization want to go through the time consuming process of establishing a learning organization? One goal for putting organizational learning concepts into practice is innovation.
english_hypothesis: An organization wants to enter the time-consuming process of establishing an educational organization to implement the concept of organizational learning innovation.

source: زمانی که از همه منابع موجود به شکلی مؤثر در واحدهای عملیاتی سازمانی استفاده شود، خلاقیت و نبوغ می‌تواند اتفاق افتد.
english_gold: When all available resources are effectively used across the functional departments of an organization, creativity and ingenuity can transpire.
english_hypothesis: When all available resources are utilized effectively in operational units of an organization, creativity and ingenuity can occur.

source: در نتیجه، روند همکاری سازمانی به منظور غلبه بر موانع می‌تواند به فرایند جدید خلاقانه‌ای در جهت تأمین نیازهای مشتری منتهی شود.
english_gold: As a result, the process of an organization working together to overcome an obstacle can lead to a new innovative process to serve the customer's need.
english_hypothesis: As a result, the organizational collaboration process to overcome obstacles can lead to a new creative process to meet customer needs.

source: قبل از اینکه یک سازمان نوآور باشد،‌ مدیریت باید یک فرهنگ نوآوری و دانش مشترک و یادگیری سازمانی ایجاد کند.
english_gold: Before an organization can be innovative, leadership must create a culture of innovation as well as shared knowledge and organizational learning.
english_hypothesis: Before an organization can be innovative, management must create a culture of innovation, shared knowledge, and organizational learning.

source: گردش علمی بخش عمده‌ای از هر کلاس درسی است. مدرس در اغلب اوقات دوست دارد که دانش‌آموزان خود را به مکانهایی ببرد که گزینه سفر با اتوبوس را نداشته باشد.
english_gold: Field trips are a large part of any classroom. Quite often a teacher would love to take her students places to which a bus trip is not an option.
english_hypothesis: Field trips are a significant part of most classes. The teacher often prefers to take his students to places where bus travel is not an option.

source: تکنولوژی با ایجاد امکان سفرهای علمی مجازی راه‌حل را ارائه می‌دهد. دانش‌آموزان می‌توانند آثار باستانی موزه‌ها را تماشا کنند، به دیدن یک آکواریوم بروند، یا هنرهای زیبا را تحسین کنند در‌حالی‌که در کنار همکلاسان خود در کلاس نشسته‌اند.
english_gold: Technology offers the solution with virtual field trips. Students can look at museum artifacts, visit an aquarium, or admire beautiful art while sitting with their class.
english_hypothesis: Technology provides a solution by making virtual scientific travel possible. Students can watch ancient museum artifacts, visit an aquarium, or appreciate beautiful art while seated alongside their classmates in class.

source: اشتراک‌گذاری یک گردش علمی نیز یک روش عالی برای منعکس نمودن در سفر و به اشتراک گذاشتن تجربیات با کلاس‌های بعدی است.
english_gold: Sharing a field trip virtually is also a great way to reflect a on a trip and share experiences with future classes.
english_hypothesis: Sharing a scientific tour is also an excellent way to reflect on the trip and share experiences with future classes.

source: به عنوان مثال، هر ساله دانش آموزان مدرسه بنت در کارولینای شمالی وب سایتی در مورد سفر خود به پایتخت ایالتی طراحی می کنند، هر ساله این وب سایت اصلاح می شود، اما نسخه‌های قدیمی بصورت آنلاین نگهداری می شوند تا دفترچه یادداشت مورد استفاده قرار گیرند.
english_gold: For example, each year students from Bennet School in North Carolina design a website about their trip to the State Capital, each year the website gets remodeled, but old versions are kept online to serve as a scrapbook.
english_hypothesis: As an example, every year, students at the Benet School in North Carolina create a website about their trip to the state capital, which is updated annually, but old versions are kept online to be used as a reference.

source: وبلاگ‌ها همچنین می‌توانند به پیشرفت مهارت نوشتن دانش‌آموز کمک کنند. گرچه دانش‌آموزان اغلب وبلاگ‌نویسی خود را با گرامر و املای درهم و برهم آغاز می‌کنند، حضور مخاطب عموماً در این موضوع تغییر ایجاد می‌کند.
english_gold: Blogs can also help improve student writing. While students often begin their blog experience with sloppy grammar and spelling, the presence of an audience generally changes that.
english_hypothesis: Blogs can also help students improve their writing skills. Although students often start their blogging with grammatical and spelling errors, the presence of an audience usually prompts them to correct these mistakes.

source: از آنجا که دانش آموزان اغلب نکته‌سنج‌ترین مخاطب هستند، نویسنده وبلاگ برای جلوگیری از انتقاد، در جهت بهبود نوشتن تلاش می کند.
english_gold: Since students are often the most critical audience, the blog writer begins to strive to improve writing to avoid criticism.
english_hypothesis: Because students are often the most discerning audience, the blogger strives to improve their writing to avoid criticism.

source: اگرچه وبلاگ‌نویسی «دانشجویان را مجبور می‌کند که درباره دنیای اطراف خود ادراک بیشتری داشته باشند،» ولی نیاز به تأمین علاقه مخاطب دانشجوها را ترغیب به هوشیاری و علاقمندی می‌کند (Toto, 2004).
english_gold: Also blogging "forces students to become more savvy about the world around them." The need to feed the interest of the audience inspires students to be clever and interesting (Toto, 2004).
english_hypothesis: Although blogging forces students to have a more profound perception of the world around them, it also requires providing the audience with interest to encourage students to be aware and interested.

source: وبلاگ‌نویسی ابزاری است که الهام‌بخش همکاری بوده و دانش‌آموزان را ترغیب می‌کند تا یادگیری را فراتر از برنامه‌های روزانه سنتی مدرسه گسترش دهند.
english_gold: Blogging is a tool that inspires collaboration, and encourages students to extend learning well beyond the traditional school day.
english_hypothesis: Blogging is a tool that has inspired collaboration and encouraged students to extend their learning beyond traditional school programs.

source: استفاده مناسب از وبلاگ‌ها «می‌تواند به دانش‌آموزان کمک کند تا به فردی تحلیلی‌تر و نقادتر تبدیل شوند؛ و از طریق پاسخ فعالانه به مطالب اینترنتی، دانش‌آموزان می‌توانند مواضع خود را در متن نوشته‌های دیگران تعریف کنند و همچنین دیدگاه‌های خود را درمورد موضوعات خاص مطرح کنند» (اوراوک، 2002).
english_gold: Appropriate use of blogs "can empower students to become more analytical and critical; through actively responding to Internet materials, students can define their positions in the context of others' writings as well as outline their own perspectives on particular issues (Oravec, 2002).
english_hypothesis: Proper use of blogs "can help students become more analytical and critical; and through actively responding to online content, students can define their positions within the written texts of others and also express their views on specific topics."

source: در این شاتل حمل و نقل دینامیکی هر کس به نحوی به یک سیستم حمل و نقل برپایه اتومبیل‌های شخصی متصل است و با آن پشتیبانی می‌شود.
english_gold: In this dynamic transport shuttle everyone is somehow connected with, and supporting, a transport system based on private cars.
english_hypothesis: In this shuttle, dynamic transportation is connected to and supported by a personal vehicle-based transportation system in a way that each person is connected to it.

source: خوشبختانه، رانندگان تمایل دارند در یک محدوده مناسب و منطقی رفتار کنند؛ بنابراین، جریان‌های ترافیکی تمایل دارند تا قوامی منطقی داشته باشند و این موضوع را می توان تقریباً از نظر ریاضی مشخص کرد.
english_gold: Fortunately, drivers tend to behave within a reasonably consistent range; thus, traffic streams tend to have some reasonable consistency and can be roughly represented mathematically.
english_hypothesis: Fortunately, drivers tend to behave within a reasonable and logical range; therefore, traffic flows tend to be logical and this can be mathematically quantified.

source: برای نمایش بهتر جریان ترافیک، روابط بین سه مشخصه تعیین شده است: 1) جریان، 2)تراکم، و 3) شتاب.
english_gold: To better represent traffic flow, relationships have been established between the three main characteristics: (1) flow, (2) density, and (3) velocity.
english_hypothesis: To better display traffic flow, relationships between the three defined characteristics have been established: 1) flow, 2) density, and 3) acceleration.

source: این روابط به برنامه‌ریزی، طراحی و عملیات تسهیلات جاده‌ای کمک می‌کند.
english_gold: These relationships help in planning, design, and operations of roadway facilities.
english_hypothesis: This relationship helps with the planning, design, and operation of road facilities.

source: بنابراین، وقتی مداد بیرون آمد، برای بسیاری از افراد دوست خوبی شد.
english_gold: Thus, the pencil was a good friend to many people when it came out.
english_hypothesis: So, when the pencil came out, it became a good friend to many people.

source: متأسفانه، با ظهور روش‌های جدیدتر نوشتن، مداد کمتر مورد استفاده قرار می‌گیرد.
english_gold: Sadly, as newer methods of writing have emerged, the pencil has been relegated to lesser status and uses.
english_hypothesis: Unfortunately, with the advent of newer writing methods, the pencil is used less and less.

source: امروزه مردم پیام‌های خود را روی صفحه نمایش رایانه می‌نویسند، و هیچ وقت مجبور نیستند به مداد‌تراش نزدیک شوند.
english_gold: People now write messages on computer screens, never having to come close to a sharpener.
english_hypothesis: Today, people write their messages on the computer screen, and they never have to get close to a pencil sharpener.

source: فقط می‌توان متعجب بود که وقتی چیزی هرگز جور در نمی‌آید، ردیف مضراب چگونه خواهد بود.
english_gold: One can only wonder what the keyboard will become when something newer comes along.
english_hypothesis: One can only be amazed at how the rhythm of the mallets will be when something never fits together.

source: تمدن دره ایندوس تمدن عصر برنز در شمال غربی شبه قاره هند بود که بیشتر پاکستان امروزی و برخی مناطق در شمال غربی هند و شمال شرقی افغانستان را شامل می شد.
english_gold: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.
english_hypothesis: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilization in the northwestern part of the Indian subcontinent, covering most of modern-day Pakistan, some areas in northwestern India, and northeastern Afghanistan.

source: این تمدن در آبگیر رودخانه ایندوس شکوفا شد و نام خود را از آن می‌گیرد.
english_gold: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.
english_hypothesis: This civilization flourished in the Indus River delta and took its name from it.

source: اگرچه برخی از محققان گمان می‌كنند مناسب‌تر است تمدنی که در آبگیر خشك شده رودخانه سرسوتی نیز وجود داشته را تمدن دره سند-سرسوتی بنامیم، این درحالیست‌که برخی به خاطر نخستین سایت حفاری در دهه 1920 در هاراپا به آن تمدن هارپان می‌گویند.
english_gold: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.
english_hypothesis: Although some researchers believe it would be more suitable to name the civilization that existed in the dried-up riverbed of the Saraswati River as the Indus-Saraswati Civilization, some others call it the Harappan Civilization because the first excavation site was discovered in Harappa in the 1920s.

source: تقریباً در هر خانه ای در شهرهای هاراپا و موهنجو-دارو توالت مجهز به فلاش تانک که به یک سیستم فاضلاب پیشرفته متصل است، وجود دارد.
english_gold: The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had a flush toilet in almost every house, attached to a sophisticated sewage system.
english_hypothesis: In almost every house in the cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-Daro, there is a toilet equipped with a flush tank connected to an advanced sewage system.

source: در آب و هوای گرم خاورمیانه، خانه زیاد اهمیت نداشت.
english_gold: In the warm climate of the Middle East, the house was not so important.
english_hypothesis: In the hot climate of the Middle East, the house didn't matter much.

source: بیشتر دوران زندگی این خانواده یهودی در فضای باز گذشت.
english_gold: Most of the life of the Hebrew family happened in the open air.
english_hypothesis: Most of this Jewish family's life was spent outdoors.

source: زنان آشپزی را در حیاط انجام می‌دادند؛ فروشگاه‌ها هم عبارت بود از پیشخوان‌های بازی که به خیابان نگاه می‌کرد. از سنگ برای ساخت خانه‌ها استفاده شده بود.
english_gold: Women did the cooking in the yard; stores were just open counters looking into the street. Stone was used for building houses.
english_hypothesis: Women cooked in the courtyard; the shops were also counters that looked onto the street. Stone was used for building houses.

source: در سرزمین کنعان جنگل‌های بزرگی وجود نداشت، بنابراین چوب بسیار گران‌قیمت بود.
english_gold: There were no large forests in the land of Canaan, so wood was extremely expensive.
english_hypothesis: In the land of Canaan, there were no large forests, so wood was very expensive.

source: زبان‌های رسمی بارسلونا عبارتند از کاتالان و اسپانیایی. حدود نیمی از مردم ترجیح می‌دهند به کاتالان صحبت کنند، اکثریت قریب به اتفاق این زبان را می‌فهمند و تقریباً همه اسپانیایی می‌دانند.
english_gold: Barcelona's official languages are Catalan and Spanish. About a half prefer to speak Catalan, a vast majority understands it, and virtually everyone knows Spanish.
english_hypothesis: The official languages of Barcelona are Catalan and Spanish. About half of the people prefer to speak Catalan, the majority understand it almost perfectly, and almost everyone speaks Spanish.

source: با این حال، بیشتر علائم فقط به زبان کاتالان هستند زیرا در قانون به‌عنوان نخستین زبان رسمی شناخته شده است.
english_gold: However, most signs are indicated only in Catalan because it is established by law as the first official language.
english_hypothesis: However, most signs are only in Catalan because it is recognized as the first official language in the law.

source: با وجود این، اسپانیایی نیز در حمل و نقل عمومی و سایر مکان‌ها به‌طور گسترده استفاده می‌شود.
english_gold: Yet, Spanish is also widely used in public transport and other facilities.
english_hypothesis: Despite this, Spanish is also widely used in public transportation and other places.

source: اطلاعیه‌های عادی در مترو تنها به زبان کاتالونیایی بیان می‌شوند، اما اختلالات خارج از برنامه را یک سیستم خودکار به انواع زبان‌ها از جمله اسپانیایی، انگلیسی، فرانسوی، عربی و ژاپنی اعلام می‌کند.
english_gold: Regular announcements in the Metro are made only in Catalan, but unplanned disruptions are announced by an automated system in a wide variety of languages including Spanish, English, French, Arabic and Japanese.
english_hypothesis: Announcements in the metro are usually made in Catalan, but disruptions outside of regular hours are announced in multiple languages, including Spanish, English, French, Arabic, and Japanese.

source: قبل از سفر و موقع سفر موارد بسیاری هست که باید لحاظ کنید.
english_gold: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.
english_hypothesis: Before and during the trip, there are many things to consider.

source: وقتی مسافرت می‌کنید، انتظار داشته باشید چیزها مانند «خانه‌تان نباشد.» روش‌ها، قوانین، مواد غذایی، ترافیک، محل اسکان، استانداردها، زبان و غیره تا حدی با مکان زندگی شما متفاوت است.
english_gold: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.
english_hypothesis: When traveling, expect things to be "not like home." Methods, rules, food, traffic, accommodations, standards, language, and so on will differ to some extent from your place of residence.

source: این را باید همیشه در ذهنتان نگه دارید تا از مأیوس شدن یا شاید حتی زده شدن از روش‌های معمول انجام امور جلوگیری کنید.
english_gold: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.
english_hypothesis: This should always be in your mind to prevent becoming hopeless or even defeated by the usual methods of doing things.

source: اگر برای اولین بار به یک کشور در حال توسعه سفر می کنید - یا به بخشی جدید از جهان - شوک بالقوه فرهنگی را دست کم نگیرید.
english_gold: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.
english_hypothesis: When traveling to a developing country or a new part of the world for the first time, do not underestimate the potential cultural shock.

source: بسیاری از مسافران تغییر ناپذیر و توانا با چیزهای جدید در مسافرت در کشورهای در حال توسعه شوکه شدند جایی که تغییرات فرهنگی خیلی کوچک خیلی سریع افزایش می‌یابد.
english_gold: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.
english_hypothesis: Many travelers were shocked by the unchanging and capable nature of things in travel to developing countries, where cultural changes occur very quickly and very rapidly.

source: به‌خصوص در روزهای اولیه‌تان روی خوش‌گذرانی به سبک غربی و استفاده از هتل‌های لوکس، غذا و خدمات برای خو گرفتن به شرایط جدید بهره ببرید.
english_gold: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.
english_hypothesis: You can enjoy the Western-style festivities and luxurious hotels, food, and services during the initial days to get accustomed to the new environment.

source: گلف نوعی بازی است که بازیکنان با استفاده از چوب گلف به توپ ضربه می‌زنند و آن را داخل سوراخ‌ها می‌اندازند.
english_gold: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.
english_hypothesis: Golf is a game in which players hit a ball into holes using a golf club.

source: طی یک دور معمول از بازی، با هجده سوراخ بازی می‌شود، به‌طوری که بازیکنان معمولاً از اولین سوراخ زمین شروع و با سوراخ هجدهم بازی را تمام می‌کنند.
english_gold: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.
english_hypothesis: In a typical round of the game, eighteen holes are played, with players usually starting from the first hole and completing the game at the eighteenth hole.

source: بازیکنی که برای تکمیل این دوره کمترین ضربه یا تلوتلو را در باشگاه بخورد، برنده می شود.
english_gold: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.
english_hypothesis: The player who suffers the least damage or shock in this round wins.

source: این بازی روی چمن انجام می‌شود و چمن دور سوراخ کوتاه‌تر زده می‌شود و ناحیه سبز نامیده می‌شود.
english_gold: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.
english_hypothesis: This game is played on the grass, and the grass around the short hole is cut and called the green.

source: سلول، واحد پایه همه موجودات زنده است و همه موجودات از یک یا چند سلول تشکیل شده‌اند.
english_gold: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.
english_hypothesis: The cell is the basic unit of all living organisms, and all living things are composed of one or more cells.

source: در مطالعه حیات، سلول‌ها در واقع آنقدر موضوع پایه و اساسی هستند که غالباً با نام «سنگ بنای حیات» از آن یاد می‌شود.
english_gold: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".
english_hypothesis: Cells are so fundamental to the study of life that they are often referred to as the "building blocks of life."

source: کلمه «Cell» انگلیسی از واژه لاتین «cella» گرفته شده که به معنی اتاق کوچک است.
english_gold: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.
english_hypothesis: The English word "cell" is derived from the Latin word "cella," meaning a small room.

source: یک زیست شناس انگلیسی به نام «رابرت هوک»‌ مربع‌های کوچکی توسط میکروسکوپ در چوب پنبه مشاهده کرد.
english_gold: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.
english_hypothesis: An English biologist named Robert Hooke observed small squares in wood pulp using a microscope.

source: شبیه به اتاق به نظر می‌رسیدند. او اولین نفری بود که سلولهای مرده را مشاهده می‌کرد.
english_gold: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells
english_hypothesis: They seemed like a room. He was the first person to see the dead cells.

source: ساز و کار ام‌آرآی بر پایه پدیده‌ای در علم فیزیک است به نام رزونانس مغناطیسی هسته‌ای (NMR)، که در دهه 1930 توسط فلیکس بلوچ (فعال در دانشگاه استانفورد) و ادوارد پورسل (از دانشگاه هاروارد) کشف شد.
english_gold: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).
english_hypothesis: The concept of MRI is based on a phenomenon in physics known as nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR). This phenomenon was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch, a researcher at Stanford University, and Edward Purcell, a researcher at Harvard University.

source: در این رزونانس، میدان مغناطیسی و امواج رادیویی باعث می‌شود اتم‌ها سیگنال‌های رادیویی کوچکی را از خود بیرون دهند.
english_gold: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.
english_hypothesis: In this resonance, the magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to emit small radio signals.

source: در سال 1970، ریموند دامادیان، پزشک و دانشمند محقق، اساس استفاده از تصویربرداری رزونانس مغناطیسی را به عنوان ابزاری برای تشخیص پزشکی کشف کرد.
english_gold: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.
english_hypothesis: In 1970, Raymond Damadian, a physician and researcher, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a medical diagnostic tool.

source: در سال 1977، دکتر دامادیان اولین اسکنر MRI «تمام بدن» را ساخت و آن را Indomitable (رام‌نشدنی) نامید.
english_gold: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.
english_hypothesis: In 1977, Dr. Damadian created the first whole-body MRI scanner and named it "Indomitable."

source: اگر فیلم «گنج ملی» را تماشا کرده باشید ممکن است فکر کنید که یک نقشه گنج در پشت اعلامیه استقلال نوشته شده است.
english_gold: If you have watched the movie National Treasure, you may think a treasure map was written on the back of the Declaration of Independence.
english_hypothesis: If you have seen the film "National Treasure," you might think that a treasure map is written on the back of the Declaration of Independence.

source: با این حال، چنان چیزی درست نیست. با اینکه چیزی پشت سند نوشته شده است، این سند نقشه گنج نیست.
english_gold: However, that is not true. Although there is something written on the back of the document, it is not a treasure map.
english_hypothesis: This document is not a treasure map, even though something is written on it.

source: در پشت اعلامیه استقلال این عبارت نوشته شده بود «اعلامیه اصلی استقلال مورخ 4 جولای 1776». متن در پایین سند، به شکل وارونه ظاهر می شود.
english_gold: Written on the back of the Declaration of Independence were the words "Original Declaration of Independence dated 4th July 1776". The text appears on the bottom of the document, upside down.
english_hypothesis: The phrase "Declaration of Independence" was written on the back of the document, and the text at the bottom of the document appears reversed.

source: در حالی که هنوز کسی نمی‌داند چه کسی آن را نوشته اما معروف است که این سند بزرگ خطی در اوایل عمر خود، (با ابعاد 29¾ اینچ در 24½ اینچ) برای نگهداری آویزان شده بود.
english_gold: While no one knows for certain who wrote it, it is known that early in its life, the large parchment document (it measures 29¾ inches by 24½ inches) was rolled up for storage.
english_hypothesis: While no one knows who wrote it, it is well-known that this large scroll, measuring 29¾ inches by 24½ inches, was hung up for storage in the early days of its existence.

source: بنابراین، این احتمال هست که یادداشت‌ صرفاً به‌عنوان برچسب الصاق شده باشد.
english_gold: So, it is likely that the notation was added simply as a label.
english_hypothesis: Therefore, it is possible that the note was simply attached as a label.

source: علامت «کمان رو به بالا» مانند یک V است و «علامت کمان رو به پایین» مانند منگنه یا یک مربع بدون قسمت انتهایی است.
english_gold: The "up bow" mark looks like a V and the "down bow mark" like a staple or a square missing its bottom side.
english_hypothesis: The "upward-facing arc" symbol is like a V, and the "downward-facing arc" symbol is like a hook or a square without a bottom section.

source: بالا یعنی باید از نوک شروع کنید و آرشه را بکشید، و پایین یعنی باید از پاشنه (که همان محل گرفتن آرشه توسط دست است) شروع کنید و آرشه را به جلو ببرید.
english_gold: Up means you should start at the tip and push the bow, and down means you should start at the frog (which is where your hand is holding the bow) and pull the bow.
english_hypothesis: To play the violin, you must start from the tip and draw the bow, and to play the viola, you must start from the heel (where the bow is held) and move the bow forward.

source: معمولاً کشیدن آرشه به‌طرف دسته ویولون صدایی نرمتر ایجاد می‌کند، در‌حالی‌که حرکت عکس آن قوی‌تر و محکم‌تر است.
english_gold: An up-bow usually generates a softer sound, while a down-bow is stronger and more assertive.
english_hypothesis: Drawing the bow towards the violin's body typically produces a softer sound, while moving it in the opposite direction yields a stronger and more forceful sound.

source: علامت‌های خود را آزادانه با مداد بکشید، اما به یاد داشته باشید که علامت‌های چاپ شده آرشه در آنجا جنبه موسیقیایی دارند، بنابراین معمولا باید به آنها احترام گذاشت.
english_gold: Feel free to pencil in your own marks, but remember the printed bowing marks are there for a musical reason, so they should usually be respected.
english_hypothesis: Draw your marks freely with a pencil, but remember that printed marks on the bow have a musical aspect, so they usually deserve respect.

source: خرده‌فرهنگ‌ها افراد هم‌عقیده را که احساس می‌کنند طبق معیارهای جامعه به آنها بی‌توجهی می‌شود کنار یکدیگر جمع می‌کنند و به آنها ایجاد توسعه حس هویت می‌دهند.
english_gold: Subcultures bring together like-minded individuals who feel neglected by societal standards and allow them to develop a sense of identity.
english_hypothesis: Subcultures bring together individuals with similar beliefs who feel ignored by society according to its standards, and give them a sense of identity and belonging.

source: خرده فرهنگ‌ها بنا به سن، قومیت، طبقه، محل زندگی و/یا جنسیت اعضا می‌توانند متمایز باشند.
english_gold: Subcultures can be distinctive because of the age, ethnicity, class, location, and/or gender of the members.
english_hypothesis: Subcultures can differ based on age, ethnicity, social class, place of residence, and/or gender of their members.

source: خصوصیاتی که یک خرده فرهنگ را متمایز می‌کند ممکن است خصوصیات زبانی، زیبایی شناختی، مذهبی، سیاسی، جنسی، جغرافیایی یا ترکیبی از این خصوصیات باشد.
english_gold: The qualities that determine a subculture as distinct may be linguistic, aesthetic, religious, political, sexual, geographical, or a combination of factors.
english_hypothesis: The characteristics that distinguish a subculture may include linguistic, aesthetic, religious, political, gender, geographical, or a combination of these characteristics.

source: اعضای یک خرده فرهنگ اغلب عضویت خود را از طریق استفاده متمایز و نمادین از سبک، که شامل مد، اطوار و گویش عامدانه است، نشان می‌دهند.
english_gold: Members of a subculture often signal their membership through a distinctive and symbolic use of style, which includes fashions, mannerisms, and argot.
english_hypothesis: Members of a subculture often express their membership through distinctive and symbolic use of style, which includes fashion, mannerisms, and deliberate speech patterns.

source: مقبره «توتنخامن» (KV62). احتمالاً KV62 مشهورترین مقبره‌ در این درّه است، جایی که «هاوارد کارتر» در سال 1922 تدفین سلطنتی پادشاه جوان را تقریباً دست نخورده کشف کرد.
english_gold: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.
english_hypothesis: The tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 is probably the most famous tomb in this valley, where Howard Carter discovered the undisturbed burial of the young king in 1922.

source: با این وجود در مقایسه با بسیاری از مقبره‌های سلطنتی دیگر، مقبره توت‌عنخ‌آمون بسیار کوچک‌تر است و تزئینات محدودی دارد به همین خاطر به سختی ارزش دیدن دارد.
english_gold: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.
english_hypothesis: In comparison to many other royal tombs, the tomb of Tutankhamun is very small and has limited decorations, which makes it hard to justify visiting.

source: هرکسی که علاقه‌مند است شواهد آسیب وارد شده به مومیایی در حین خارج کردنش از تابوت را مشاهده کند، ناامید می‌شود زیرا فقط سر و شانه‌ها قابل مشاهده هستند.
english_gold: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.
english_hypothesis: Anyone interested in seeing the evidence of damage inflicted on the mummy during its removal from the coffin will be disappointed, as only the head and shoulders are visible.

source: ثروت‌های شگفت انگیز این مقبره دیگر درون آن قرار ندارد، بلکه به موزه مصر در قاهره برده شده است.
english_gold: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.
english_hypothesis: The treasures of this mausoleum are no longer within it, but have been taken to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

source: یکی از نقاط قوت شارلوت، کالیفرنیای شمالی وجود آپشن‌های با کیفیت فراوان برای خانواده‌هاست.
english_gold: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.
english_hypothesis: One of the strengths of Charlotte, North Carolina, is the abundance of high-quality family-friendly options.

source: ساکنان مناطق دیگر اغلب خانوادگی بودن آنجا را دلیل اصلی نقل مکان به آنجا ذکر می کنند و بازدیدکنندگان اغلب از این شهر لذت می‌برند و کودکان در اطراف آنها بازی می‌کنند.
english_gold: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.
english_hypothesis: Residents of other areas often cite family-friendly atmosphere as the main reason for moving there, and visitors often enjoy the city and children play around them.

source: در 20 سال گذشته، میزان گزینه‌های دوستدار کودک در مرکز تجاری شارلوت به‌صورت تصاعدی افزایش یافته است.
english_gold: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.
english_hypothesis: In the past 20 years, the number of child-friendly options at the Charlotte Center has increased exponentially.

source: عموماً در شارلوت خانواده‌ها از تاکسی استفاده نمی‌کنند، هرچند در شرایط خاص ممکن است مورد استفاده قرار بگیرند.
english_gold: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.
english_hypothesis: In Charlotte, families generally do not use taxis, although they may be used in special circumstances.

source: لطفاً به خاطر داشته باشید که اساساً در حال بازدید از محل یک گور دسته‌جمعی هستید و همچنین محلی که برای بخش قابل توجهی از مردم جهان دارای معنای تقریباً غیرقابل محاسبه ای است.
english_gold: Please remember that you are essentially visiting a mass grave site, as well as a site that has an almost incalculable meaning to a significant portion of the world's population.
english_hypothesis: Please remember that you are essentially visiting a mass grave and a place that holds a meaning almost beyond comprehension for a significant portion of the world's population.

source: هنوز مردان و زنان بسیاری هستند که از اینجا جان سالم به در برده‌اند، و بسیاری دیگر عزیزانی داشتند که در آنجا به قتل رسیده یا آنقدر کار کرده‌اند که مرده‌اند، یهودی و غیریهودی فرقی نمی‌کرد.
english_gold: There are still many men and women alive who survived their time here, and many more who had loved ones who were murdered or worked to death there, Jews and non-Jews alike.
english_hypothesis: There are still many men and women who have survived from here, and many more loved ones who have been killed or worked to death there, without distinction between Jew and non-Jew.

source: لطفاً از این محل با تمام شأن، افتخار و احترامی که لایق آن است دیدن کنید. درباره هولوکاست یا نازی‌ها لطیفه نگویید.
english_gold: Please treat the site with all of the dignity, solemnity and respect it deserves. Do not make jokes about the Holocaust or Nazis.
english_hypothesis: Please view this place with the dignity, honor, and respect it deserves. Do not make jokes about the Holocaust or the Nazis.

source: با نقاشی دیواری یا حک کردن روی بناها این مکان را از شکل نیندازید.
english_gold: Do not deface the site by marking or scratching graffiti into structures.
english_hypothesis: Do not alter the appearance of this place by painting murals or carving on the buildings.

source: بعضی افراد معتقدند تجربه کردن بسیاری رؤیاهای شفاف که به‌طور مصنوعی القا شوند خود اغلب می‌تواند بسیار طاقت‌فرسا باشد.
english_gold: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.
english_hypothesis: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams can be very exhausting.

source: اثرش بستگی به این دارد که مغزتان چند وقت یکبار در هر شب برای دیدن رؤیای شفاف تلاش کند.

english_gold: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.
english_hypothesis: More than 60 ocean-going ships pass through the waters of the Galapagos Islands, accommodating between 8 and 100 passengers.

source: اغلب افراد مکان‌شان را از پیش رزرو می‌کنند (چون قایق‌ها معمولاً در طول فصل‌های شلوغ پر می‌شوند).
english_gold: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).
english_hypothesis: Most people book their place in advance (as the boats are usually full during peak seasons).

source: دقت کنید که متصدی آژانسی که نزد او رزرو می‌کنید متخصص گالاپاگوس باشد و اطلاعات خوبی از انواع گسترده کشتی‌ها داشته باشد.
english_gold: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.
english_hypothesis: Please note that the agent you book with should be a Galapagos specialist and have good knowledge of the various types of ships.

source: این کار تضمین می‌کند که علایق و/یا محدودیت‌های خاص شما با کشتی که برایشان مناسب‌تر است هماهنگ شود.
english_gold: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.
english_hypothesis: This ensures that your specific interests and/or constraints align with the ship that is more suitable for you.

source: ثبت نام یک الزام اضافی برای روند دریافت ویزا است. در برخی از کشورها، شما باید حضور خود و نشانی جایی که در آن اقامت دارید را در پیش مقامات محلی ثبت کنید.
english_gold: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.
english_hypothesis: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa application process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you reside with local authorities.

source: در اینجا ممکن است نیاز باشد برای پلیس محلی فرمی پر کنید یا سری به دفاتر مهاجرت بزنید.
english_gold: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.
english_hypothesis: You may need to fill out a form for the local police or visit the immigration offices.

source: در بسیاری از کشورهایی که چنین قانونی دارند، هتل‌های محلی کار ثبت نام را انجام می دهند (حتما بپرسید).
english_gold: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).
english_hypothesis: In many countries where such a law exists, local hotels will require you to register your stay (definitely ask).

source: در موارد دیگر، فقط آنهایی که در خارج از مکان‌های توریستی اقامت دارند، نیاز به ثبت نام دارند. از آنجا که این قانون بسیار مبهم‌تر هم می‌شود، بهتر است از قبل به آن پی‌ببرید.
english_gold: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.
english_hypothesis: In other cases, only those staying outside tourist areas need to register. As this law becomes even more ambiguous, it's best to familiarize yourself with it beforehand.

source: ویژگی بسیاری از سفرهای دریایی متمایز بالتیک این است که اقامت طولانی در سن پترزبورگ، روسیه دارند.
english_gold: Most of the distinct Baltic Cruises feature an extended stay in St. Petersburg, Russia.
english_hypothesis: The distinguishing feature of many Baltic Sea cruises is the long stay in St. Petersburg, Russia.

source: این بدان معناست که می‌توانید چند روز کامل به بازدید از این شهر تاریخی بپردازید، ضمن این که شب‌ها برای خواب به کشتی برگردید.
english_gold: This means you can visit the historic city for a couple of full days while returning and sleeping on the ship at night.
english_hypothesis: This means you can spend a few full days exploring this historic city, while returning to the ship at night for rest.

source: اگر فقط توسط کشتی‌های تفریحی در ساحل پهلو بگیرید، نیازی به ویزای مجزا نخواهید داشت (از سال 2009).
english_gold: If you only go ashore using shipboard excursions you will not need a separate visa (as of 2009).
english_hypothesis: If you only dock at the shore by pleasure boats, you will not need a separate visa (from 2009).

source: برخی کروزها در بروشور خود برلین آلمان را شامل می‌شوند. اما همانطور که می‌توانید از نقشه بالا برلین را مشاهده کنید، هیچ قسمتی از این شهر به دریا نزدیک نیست و بازدید از این شهر در هزینه کروز گنجانده نشده است.
english_gold: Some cruises feature Berlin, Germany in the brochures. As you can see from the map above Berlin is no where near the sea and a visit to the city is not included in the price of the cruise.
english_hypothesis: Some cruises include Berlin, Germany, in their brochures. However, as you can see from the map above, Berlin is not near the sea, and visiting this city is not included in the cost of the cruise.
